6931a44e.title: Solution Architect – Application Development & Modernization
6931a44e.description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 We are seeking a customer\-focused Solution Architect to drive Application Development and Modernization initiatives. The role involves engaging with clients to understand business challenges, assessing existing application landscapes, defining target\-state architectures, and designing scalable, secure, and cloud\-ready solutions. The Solution Architect will collaborate with Sales, Delivery, Engineering, and Technology teams to deliver innovative solutions aligned with business objectives and digital transformation strategies.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Requirement Discovery** 



* Engage with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business objectives, technical challenges, and target\-state outcomes.
* Conduct technical discovery workshops and requirement\-gathering sessions.
* Analyze existing application architecture and identify modernization opportunities.
* Recommend technology solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.



  
 



**Solution Architecture \& Design** 



* Design scalable, secure, and resilient applications using modern technologies such as .NET, Java, Python, Microservices, and REST APIs.
* Architect cloud\-native solutions on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Define end\-to\-end solution architecture covering application, integration, data, security, and infrastructure layers.
* Apply DevSecOps principles including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization (Docker), and Kubernetes.
* Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, availability, reliability, and security requirements.



  
 



**Technical Solutioning** 



* Translate business requirements into comprehensive technical solution designs.
* Prepare architecture diagrams, technical proposals, and solution documentation.
* Support effort estimation, sizing, technology selection, and cost optimization.
* Provide technical guidance throughout the solution lifecycle.



  
 



**Client Engagement** 



* Lead technical discussions, architecture workshops, and solution presentations with business and IT stakeholders.
* Present solution approaches, modernization strategies, and technology recommendations.
* Conduct Proof of Concept (POC) demonstrations to validate proposed solutions.
* Build trusted relationships with clients by providing technical expertise and strategic guidance.



  
 



**Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Sales, Delivery, Engineering, Product, and Cloud teams to ensure successful solution implementation.
* Support proposal development, RFP/RFI responses, and technical documentation.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies, cloud services, and application modernization best practices.



  
 



**Core Skills Required** 









**Technical Expertise** 



* Strong understanding of Application Architecture and System Design.
* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Strong knowledge of Microservices, REST APIs, and Event\-Driven Architectures.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure Automation.
* Strong understanding of secure application design principles.
* Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns and cloud\-native application development.



  
 



**Soft Skills** 



* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and presentation abilities.
* Ability to engage with business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.



  
 



**Experience** 



* 10\-15 years of overall IT experience.
* 4\-5 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, Enterprise Solution Design, or Application Modernization.
* Experience designing cloud\-native and enterprise applications.
* Prior experience in application development or modernization projects is preferred.
* Experience engaging with clients, understanding business requirements, and delivering technical solutions.



  
 



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience with Cloud Migration and Application Modernization.
* Understanding of API Management, Integration Platforms, and Enterprise Architecture.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled applications and modern software development practices.
* Cloud Certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) are an added advantage.

d855411c.title: AI Solution Architect
d855411c.description:
* AI \& Solutions Architect
* Job Title \- AI \& Solutions Architect
* Location – Pune
* Experience – 10\+ years
* About Silicon Stack



 Silicon Stack is an Australian technology services company with a strong delivery base in Pune. We provide GCC staffing, AI and data engineering, application development, and managed services to enterprise clients across the automotive, industrial, and technology sectors. Our India team of approximately 150 engineers, data scientists, architects, and delivery professionals works across concurrent technology programmes at any given time.
 



  




* The Role We are looking for an AI \& Solutions Architect who combines strong technical depth in AI/ML and cloud architecture with communication skills to engage credibly with senior client stakeholders. This is not a pure engineering role — it sits at the intersection of architecture, solution design, and client advisory. The right person has built real AI products or platforms, understands how enterprise technology landscapes fit together, and can translate complex technical ideas into clear proposals and presentations. This is a growth role — the expectation is that the person develops into the practice's primary technical authority over the next 18–24 months. Key Responsibilities AI \& Architecture — 50% of the role • Own the architectural direction for AI, GenAI, machine learning, and data engineering deliveries across the practice
* • Design and review end\-to\-end solution architectures — from data ingestion and model development through to deployment and MLOps
* • Provide technical guidance to delivery teams on implementation approach, technology selection, and best practices



 • Build and maintain reusable architectural frameworks and reference architectures that accelerate delivery across the team
 



 • Evaluate and recommend new tools, platforms, and frameworks — particularly in the rapidly evolving AI and cloud landscape Technical Pre\-Sales \& Solution Design — 30% of the role
 



 • Lead technical discovery sessions with client stakeholders — understand business problems and map them to technology solutions
 



 • Own the technical section of all proposals and RFP responses — solution architecture, technology fit, delivery approach, and effort estimation
 



 • Develop and present capability presentations and solution workshops — you are the technical face of the practice in client conversations
 



 • Design service offerings — packaging technical capabilities into defined, repeatable engagement models that the commercial team can sell
 



 • Work closely with the MD and commercial team to support deals from a technical credibility standpoint Technical Leadership — 20% of the role
 



 • Mentor and develop Architects and Senior Engineers within the team — raise the technical bar across the practice
 



 • Conduct technical interviews for senior hires — define what good looks like and help the team recruit to that standard
 



 • Produce thought leadership content — articles, capability briefs, and technical documentation that builds the organisation's credibility externally
 



 • Stay ahead of the technology curve — AI, GenAI, cloud\-native architectures, agentic systems — and bring relevant developments into the practice Technology Depth Expected Strong working knowledge required across most of these areas.
 



 Depth in AI/ML and cloud is essential; breadth across the rest is expected.
 



 Domain Expected knowledge AI / GenAI Hands\-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic AI, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation frameworks. Practical experience with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Google Vertex AI. Machine Learning Model development, training, evaluation, and deployment. MLOps practices — model versioning, monitoring, drift detection. Familiarity with MLflow, SageMaker, or equivalent. Data Engineering Data pipeline architecture, ETL/ELT, data lake and warehouse design. Working knowledge of Spark, dbt, Redshift, Snowflake, or similar platforms.
 



 Cloud Architecture AWS (primary), Azure, or GCP. Cloud\-native design patterns — serverless, microservices, event\-driven architecture. Security and compliance in cloud environments.
 



 Application Architecture Backend systems — APIs, microservices, distributed systems.
 



 Familiarity with Python, Node.js, or Java in a services context. Enough to review and guide delivery teams. Integration API design, event streaming (Kafka, Kinesis), enterprise integration patterns. Sufficient to design solutions that connect AI/data layers with existing enterprise systems.
 



 What We Are Looking For Essential Preferred
 



 • 8–12 years in technology with at least 4 years in an architecture, solution design, or technical lead role
 



 • Demonstrable hands\-on AI/ML experience — has built, deployed, or led the development of at least one real AI or GenAI system
 



 • Strong cloud architecture knowledge across at least one major provider (AWS preferred)
 



 • Experience working directly with clients or senior stakeholders — can present, explain, and defend technical approaches clearly
 



 • Good written and verbal communication — you write proposals that are clear, structured, and persuasive to a non\-technical reader
 



 • Intellectually curious with a growth mindset — this role grows significantly and the person must want to grow with it
 



 • Pune\-based or willing to relocate immediately
 



 • Background in an IT services, consulting, or managed services environment
 



 • Experience designing AI or data solutions for industrial, automotive, or manufacturing clients
 



 • Exposure to technical pre\-sales — contributing to proposals, RFP responses, or solution workshops
 



 • Published technical content — blogs, talks, open\-source contributions — that demonstrates active engagement with the technology community
 



 • Familiarity with the GCC delivery model — how enterprise organisations build and run technology operations in India

**Position Summary:** 




 As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you are a trusted technical advisor embedded within the customer organisation. You work closely with sales and field engineering to accelerate adoption and growth of the Databricks platform. You ensure customer success by providing technical accountability for our most complex customers—helping them maximise the value of Databricks workloads they have already selected and improving their return on investment.
 



 This role blends deep technical leadership with strategic customer engagement. You own the post\-sales technical strategy for the customer’s highest\-value use cases and serve as their primary advisor across the Databricks platform. You engage senior technical and business leaders with strong architectural judgment—driving design reviews, performance and cost optimisation, product adoption, and rapid blocker removal. In parallel, you drive account growth by ensuring alignment with architectural best practices and measurable value realisation—building executive alignment, leading stakeholders, orchestrating specialised Databricks teams, and steering customers toward scalable, production\-grade architectures.
 



 While not a hands\-on\-keyboard role, this is a highly technical position where architectural skills in fields such as data architecture, data engineering, data warehousing, or data science are essential.
 



 You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organisation.
 



  





**The impact you will have** 



* Be the accountable Databricks Architect for your assigned customers, working with technical teams to guide priority use cases from design through go\-live—removing blockers, providing best practices, and ensuring stable, scalable adoption.
* Lead the post\-technical\-win strategy and execution plan for major Databricks use cases, aligning with Solutions Architects to understand full demand plans and drive clarity across multiple selling teams and stakeholders.
* Own the technical leadership of assigned use cases, creating certainty from ambiguity and coordinating onboarding, enablement, success, go\-live, and healthy consumption of workloads selected for Databricks.
* Serve as the first point of contact for production/go\-live status, often across multiple complex use cases within large enterprise organisations.
* Orchestrate the broader Databricks ecosystem—Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services, Support, and specialist technical teams—to ensure high\-quality delivery and escalate advanced issues when needed.
* Create and execute a point of view for accelerating use cases into production, collaborating with Professional Services on proposals as needed.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to introduce new capabilities, private previews, and upgrade paths that support customer roadmaps.
* Develop and manage a unified technical execution plan covering:
* progression of priority use cases from technical win through production
* user enablement and growth
* product adoption aligned with the Lakehouse vision
* cloud cost control, tuning, and optimisation
* executive and operational governance
* Provide clear internal and external updates, including KPI reporting on usage, customer health, investment status, risks, product adoption, and use case progression.



  





**What we look for** 



* Programming experience in Python, SQL, or Scala, and a solid understanding of distributed data systems.
* 5\+ years of experience delivering Data, Analytics, or AI projects, with the ability to contribute to architectural discussions with customers.
* Experience in customer\-facing technical roles such as technical architecture, pre\-sales, consulting, or customer success.
* Ability to guide architectural decisions in domains such as data engineering, data architecture, data warehousing, or data science.
* Demonstrated ability to drive delivery outcomes without hands\-on keyboard responsibilities.
* Experience resolving complex escalations with senior customer stakeholders.
* Understanding of how to connect technical deliverables to business value.
* Track record of achieving or exceeding goals or objectives.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

c741daf0.title: Senior Architect
c741daf0.description:
**About The Job**
 The Red Hat India Services team is looking for a Consulting Senior Architect to join us in India. In this role, you will help us ensure that our engagements are not just a technology implementation, but an organizational transformation. As a senior Architect, you will serve as the lead architect in our engagements, cocreating innovative software solutions using emerging open source technology and modern software design methods in an agile environment. You’ll coach the team and facilitate the design and technical delivery of our solutions. As you do so, you’ll create enthusiasm for building great software using principles of open source and agile culture. You'll support everything from the scoping to delivering the engagements. This role ideally suits a senior, directly involved architect with a passion for coaching teams, design, communication, and delivering complex solutions. Successful applicants must reside in a country where Red Hat is registered to do business.
   

  

**What Will You Do**
* Deliver successful discovery, analysis, and design workshops for small to medium teams of both technical and non\-technical backgrounds that shape and influence customer use cases and architecture design decisions
* Scope delivery projects and guide customers through successful pilot and production deployments
* Lead the discovery, architecture, design, and implementation of application prototypes in our delivery of solutions using modern application development practices and emerging open source technologies
* Help us cover domains including microservices, API management, and web\-scale architectures, DevOps engineering and application delivery, container\-based continuous delivery (CD), i.e., using Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform, cloud automation, and Everything as Code
* Team up with Red Hat and the open source community to engineer innovation\-based software solutions, designed to further accelerate our customers’ success at their transformation journey
* Work as a trusted adviser to our customers and use your critical thinking skills to tackle tough problems in an innovative way
* Train and coach team members both on technical and non\-technical skills
* Present vision, strategy, technology, and roadmaps to executives, technical management, engineers, and operators
* Remain an active coder as this is required during our engagements and maintain deep direct technical knowledge of container management systems (CMSs), application infrastructure, architectures, and development solutions
* Support presales and post\-sales field teams during workshops, proofs of concepts, pilots, and production deployments
* Actively contribute to and guide the creation of reference architectures, design considerations, and best practices
* Assist in the development of standard reusable consulting service offerings, including the definition of tasks, deliverables, and standard estimates


**What Will You Bring**
* At least 20 years of experience in building and leading large\-scale software applications
* Experience in setting up Kafka and platform
* Hands\-on experience with Service Mesh technologies, including Istio, for traffic management, security, and observability in microservices architectures.
* Experience in building web applications
* Experience in designing and integrating RESTful APIs
* Hands on experience in onboarding application into Kubernetes ensuring all best practices are followed
* Excellent debugging and optimization skills
* Experience in unit/integration testing
* Familiarity with databases (e.g. MySQL, MongoDB), web servers (e.g. Apache) and
* Familiarity UI/UX design
* Must have handled customer directly for more than 10 years
* Knowledge of different version of OpenShift and their usage
* Must have worked with Telecom customers


**About Red Hat**
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
   

  

**Inclusion at Red Hat**
 Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
   

  

 Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
   

  

 Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application\-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

f9c49f58.title: Senior Solution Architect / Technical Lead (Java)
f9c49f58.description:
Description
 



  





 About Opalus and OPAL
 



 Opalus Investments Limited is developing OPAL, an AI\-powered SaaS business operating platform for SMEs. OPAL places accounting at the core and connects finance, customers, people, projects, documents and workflow in one secure operating environment. We are establishing our software development team and office in Kochi, Kerala.
 



  





 The company has completed a high\-fidelity working prototype and is building the production\-grade platform for an initial Australian release. Opalus is now establishing a software development office and multidisciplinary product team in Kochi, Kerala, to help take OPAL through engineering, testing, release and ongoing product development.
 



  





 A permissioned AI layer is being designed across the connected business record to help users understand information, prepare work and take controlled action with appropriate approvals and audit trails.
 



  





 The opportunity
 



 Design and govern the architecture of OPAL’s secure, multi\-tenant SaaS platform and provide hands\-on technical leadership across engineering disciplines.
 



  





 What you’ll do
 


* Define the platform architecture, service boundaries, integration patterns and technical roadmap.
* Design tenant isolation, including the shared\-application and separated\-data approach appropriate to the platform.
* Define federated identity and access\-management patterns across OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML and SSO.
* Set standards for APIs, events, security, scalability, resilience, observability and auditability.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design decisions and engineering governance.
* Guide deployment, backup, disaster\-recovery and future multi\-region design decisions.
* Mentor engineers and work closely with product, QA, DevOps, data and security stakeholders.



  





 Requirements
 



  





 What you bring
 


* 10–15\+ years of professional experience.
* Deep experience with Java 17\+, Spring Boot and enterprise application architecture.
* Educational background in engineering or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of containerised and cloud\-native systems using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with API gateways and integration technologies such as Kong, NGINX or cloud\-native equivalents.
* Strong understanding of PostgreSQL, distributed data design and high\-integrity transactional systems.
* Experience with event\-driven systems using Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar technology.
* Demonstrated knowledge of SaaS security, identity, tenant isolation and compliance patterns.
* Architecture experience in accounting, ERP, banking, payments or other financial systems.
* Experience with database performance, replication, partitioning and analytical data platforms.
* Exposure to Australian accounting products and regulatory workflows.
* Experience collaborating with and influencing cross\-functional stakeholders such as product, QA, DevOps, data and security teams.
* Eligible to work in India.



  





 Location requirement
 



 This position is based in Kochi, Kerala, India. Applicants must already be based in Kochi or be willing to relocate to Kochi.
 



  





 You must be eligible to work in India.

4dea7b9b.title: AI Solutions Architect
4dea7b9b.description:
We are looking for a senior, hands\-on AI professional who can work across pre\-sales, solution architecture, rapid prototyping, team formation, and delivery.
 



  





 You will work directly with prospects and clients to understand business problems, recommend practical AI solutions, build quick proofs of concept, estimate projects, help close opportunities, form delivery teams, and remain technically accountable during implementation.
 



  





 The right candidate will combine strong client\-facing skills with current, hands\-on engineering capability.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Participate in discovery calls with founders, CTOs, CIOs, product leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Provide an initial solution direction, effort estimate, budget range, and delivery approach quickly.
* Design practical architectures for AI products, GenAI applications, AI agents, automation solutions, chatbots, predictive systems, and AI integrations.
* Personally build rapid PoCs and technical demonstrations.
* Prepare technical content for proposals, presentations, estimates, and statements of work.
* Interview and select AI engineers, data engineers, backend developers, and other specialists.
* Establish coding, evaluation, security, documentation, and review standards.
* Remain technically accountable during early delivery and transition daily execution to the appropriate technical lead.
* Support client communication during implementation, especially around technical risks and major decisions.



  





**Required Technical Skills** 



* Strong hands\-on development experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI.
* Working knowledge of Node.js or TypeScript.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, large language models, RAG, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, tool calling, and AI\-agent workflows.
* Experience integrating models and services from providers such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, databases, enterprise applications, and third\-party system integrations.
* Ability to build simple user interfaces or demonstrations using lightweight web frameworks.
* Experience deploying AI applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Docker, CI/CD, application monitoring, secrets management, and production support.
* Understanding of LLM evaluation, hallucination reduction, guardrails, observability, prompt management, latency, and cost optimization.
* Knowledge of data privacy, PII handling, access controls, tenant isolation, and secure AI architecture.
* Working knowledge of applied machine learning, predictive analytics, recommendations, computer vision, OCR, or voice AI.



  





**Required Professional Experience** 



* 10\+ years of software engineering or solution architecture experience.
* 5\+ years of experience delivering applied AI or machine learning solutions.
* Recent hands\-on experience building GenAI applications.
* Experience taking at least two AI solutions from discovery or PoC through production.
* Experience supporting pre\-sales, proposals, technical discovery, and commercial estimation.
* Experience working directly with international clients.
* Experience building, mentoring, or leading engineering teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work with speed without compromising technical quality or commercial discipline.



  





**Preferred Background** 



* Experience in an IT services, technology consulting, or product\-engineering company.
* Experience supporting AI opportunity conversion and deal closure.
* Experience delivering AI solutions for multiple industries.
* Experience working with clients across the US, UK, Europe, or the Middle East.
* Experience creating reusable AI accelerators or internal engineering frameworks.

4c3e431a.title: Tech S And T-Cloud AI Platform Engineer-ISR-Senior-GDSF02
4c3e431a.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description – Manager (Cloud AI Platform Engineer)**
**Experience:** 
 10–13 years
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 The Manager will play a pivotal role in building and scaling EY GDS's AI Strategy \& Transformation practice. This leadership role combines hands\-on cloud and AI platform engineering expertise with consulting excellence, driving end\-to\-end AI platform implementation, infrastructure modernization and enterprise deployment programs while managing senior client relationships and CxO engagements. The position demands deep technical implementation skills in AI platform and infrastructure engineering, multi\-cloud architecture, automation and deployment engineering, MLOps enablement and operationalization of AI workloads alongside proven program leadership across industries like BFSI, manufacturing and regulated sectors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**AI Platform \& Infrastructure Engineering Leadership**
* Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments.
* Architect scalable cloud\-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.
* Build secure and resilient infrastructure for AI model development, training, deployment and runtime operations including compute, GPU environments, storage, networking, secrets management and access control.
* Design reusable platform services for model hosting, inference endpoints, vector databases, prompt orchestration, agent runtime support and enterprise API integration.
* Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.
* Enable secure AI platform controls with policy enforcement, access governance, auditability and support for Responsible AI, compliance and risk requirements.
* Drive standardization of AI platform architecture through reusable patterns, landing zones, environment templates and enterprise engineering best practices.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as primary technical advisor to CxOs, account leadership teams and enterprise engineering stakeholders on AI platform strategy, cloud modernization and deployment architecture.
* Conduct technical workshops demonstrating platform blueprints, deployment models, MLOps capabilities, observability approaches and AI operational readiness.
* Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.
* Build trusted relationships through hands\-on PoC delivery, architecture discussions and strategic guidance on AI platform adoption.


**Cloud, Automation \& Deployment Engineering Leadership**
* Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.
* Design and implement CI/CD and CT pipelines for AI platforms, model deployment services, APIs, microservices and environment lifecycle management.
* Drive containerization and orchestration patterns using Docker and Kubernetes including workload isolation, autoscaling, high availability and release automation.
* Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
* Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
* Implement release engineering practices including blue\-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
* Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.


**MLOps, Data Pipelines \& Operationalization Leadership**
* Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
* Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
* Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real\-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud\-native data services.
* Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
* Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service\-level performance.
* Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise\-grade deployments.
* Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk\-sensitive environments.


**Asset and Accelerator Development**
* Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
* Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
* Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.


**Business Development \& GTM Initiatives**
* Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
* Develop industry\-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
* Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.


**Program Governance \& Delivery Excellence**
* Oversee end\-to\-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
* Manage cross\-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
* Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.


**Practice Development \& Team Leadership**
* Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
* Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
* Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
**Education:** 
 B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).
   

  

**Core Technical Expertise (Hands\-on Implementation Required):**
* AI Platform \& Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands\-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API\-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation \& Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering \& Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* Programming \& APIs: Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.
* Security \& Governance: Familiarity with platform security, secrets management, policy controls, auditability, observability and support for Responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.


**AI and Data Science Certifications (Good to have):**
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate / Azure DevOps Engineer / Azure Solutions Architect
* AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty / AWS DevOps Engineer / AWS Solutions Architect
* Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer / Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
* Additional: Kubernetes certifications (CKA / CKAD), Terraform Associate, Databricks certifications, MLOps or cloud platform engineering certifications


**Consulting \& Leadership Experience:**
* 10–13 years in cloud platform engineering, AI platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps or AI consulting (Big 4 / tech preferred).
* Proven track record leading enterprise AI platform implementations across BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare or public sector.
* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated industry deployments and multi\-cloud architecture programs.


**Soft Skills:**
* Exceptional technical storytelling for CxO audiences.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders through working prototypes, architecture deep dives and platform transformation roadmaps.
* Leadership of diverse technical teams with clear delivery focus.


**Portfolio Requirements:**
 Hands\-on experience in building production\-grade cloud AI platforms, automated deployment frameworks, MLOps pipelines and enterprise AI infrastructure is mandatory for interview stage.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

c8369c45.title: Senior Product Delivery Manager / Product Owner
c8369c45.description:
Description
 



  





 About Opalus and OPAL
 



 Opalus Investments Limited is developing OPAL, an AI\-powered SaaS business operating platform for SMEs. OPAL places accounting at the core and connects finance, customers, people, projects, documents and workflow in one secure operating environment. We are establishing our software development team and office in Kochi, Kerala.
 



  





 The opportunity
 



 Own the product direction and delivery of OPAL’s connected SaaS platform, translating customer, accounting and operational needs into a clear roadmap and an executable backlog.
 



  





 What you’ll do
 


* Define and maintain the product vision, roadmap, outcomes and release priorities.
* Own the product backlog, acceptance criteria and sprint priorities in partnership with engineering and design.
* Gather and reconcile requirements across accounting, banking, CRM, people, recruitment, projects, documents and workflow.
* Translate Australian accounting, payroll and compliance requirements into product capabilities and testable outcomes.
* Shape module packaging, product analytics and success measures using customer and operational evidence.
* Lead product life\-cycle management from discovery and validation through release and improvement.
* Coordinate architecture, engineering, UX, QA, DevOps and business stakeholders around release scope and dependencies.
* Define localisation and multi\-language requirements and support integration planning with external partners.



  





 Company description
 



 Opalus Investments Limited is developing OPAL, an AI\-powered SaaS business operating platform for small and medium\-sized businesses. With accounting at its core, OPAL is designed to connect finance, banking, customers, people, recruitment, projects, documents, workflow and reporting in one secure operating environment. A permissioned AI layer is being designed across the connected business record to help users understand information, prepare work and take controlled action with appropriate approvals and audit trails.
 



  





 The company has completed a high\-fidelity working prototype and is building the production\-grade platform for an initial Australian release. Opalus is now establishing a software development office and multidisciplinary product team in Kochi, Kerala, to help take OPAL through engineering, testing, release and ongoing product development.
 



  





 Requirements
 



  





 What you bring
 


* 8–15 years of demonstrated product ownership or product management experience in SaaS, ERP, accounting or FinTech products.
* Strong command of agile product delivery, backlog management, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Ability to work with complex workflows and multi\-tenant SaaS concepts.
* Experience coordinating with engineering, UX, QA, architecture, DevOps and business stakeholders, with strong stakeholder facilitation, prioritisation, written communication and decision\-making skills.
* Experience defining product KPIs and using evidence to guide roadmap decisions.
* Experience with payroll, recruitment, CRM or workflow integrations.



  





 Preferred experience
 


* Experience working with API\-led products.
* Exposure to Australian accounting products such as Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks Online Australia or Reckon.
* Understanding of GST, BAS, PAYG and superannuation workflows.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent product\-delivery tooling.
* Degree in Engineering.



  





 Location requirement
 



 This position is based in Kochi, Kerala, India. Applicants must already be based in Kochi or be willing to relocate to Kochi.
 



  





 You must be eligible to work in India.

36f6cd94.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
36f6cd94.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

### **About the Role**

  

We are looking for a highly accomplished Technical Program Manager (TPM) — at the Staff level — to play a pivotal role in spearheading our product development and geographic expansion initiatives. This strategic role requires a deep technical background to effectively partner with product managers and engineering managers, providing technical leadership to own the execution plan and deliver complex, cross\-team engineering initiatives. You will be the champion for predictable and timely delivery, able to take ownership of and drive the mitigation of risks to the program, and skilled in facilitating quantifiable success across diverse engineering and product teams. Your core responsibility is to ensure the predictable delivery of products by actively engaging in technical discussions, identifying and proactively resolving dependencies and technical blockers, mitigating architectural risks, and applying best\-in\-class program management practices.

 **What You'll Do**

### **Technical Strategy \& Planning**

* Drive strategic, cross\-functional planning and prioritization, partnering with Product and Engineering leadership to develop comprehensive program plans, including roadmap definition, dependency mapping, and resourcing models.
* Drive the process of translating high\-level business and product requirements into actionable, concrete engineering tasks, milestones, and technical specifications.
* Contribute to the definition and tracking of effective technical metrics, driving improvements that optimize engineering operating performance and system health.

### **Technical Execution \& Delivery**

* Lead and facilitate regular program\-level meetings and reviews with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure projects achieve successful outcomes.
* Proactively monitor program health, tracking status, risks, issues, and complex technical dependencies across engineering teams.
* Deep dive into technical issues to facilitate resolution, and drive appropriate executive\-level escalations and program\-level change management processes as\-needed.
* Take personal ownership of engineering roadblocks and technical delays, escalating issues appropriately and driving them to timely closure by working directly with engineering leads.

### **Process \& Communication**

* Manage high\-level program communications, ensuring all stakeholders—from delivery teams to executive management—are consistently informed of roadmap changes, release plans, and delivery status, with a clear explanation of technical trade\-offs and risks.
* Establish, document, and champion the adoption of new program frameworks, tools, and best practices across the R\&D organization.
* Act as an agent of change, helping to establish and strengthen the Technical Program Management function across the company.

 **Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of experience as TPM, Engineering Lead, Manager, or equivalent working directly with software engineering teams.
* Proven track record to communicate technical issues effectively to technical and non\-technical partners at different levels of the organization.
* Proven ability to build and implement detailed plans accounting for ambiguity, dependencies, and technical complexity in a fast\-moving environment.
* Demonstrated excellence in the practice of technical program management, especially in establishing TPM processes from scratch.
* Highly skilled in pragmatically identifying, tracking and reporting on cross team dependencies and collaboratively addressing them effectively with providing/receiving teams.
* Demonstrated attention to detail and a hands\-on disposition.
* Excellent problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Outstanding ability to effectively communicate across all levels of the organization from engineers to executives.
* Four\-year Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related degree, or equivalent work experience.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

59d88fea.title: Cloud Architect

59d88fea.description:
**Job Title:** Cloud Architecture \& Governance Lead

**Location:** Bangalore / In person

**Position Type:** Full\-Time

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **Cloud Architecture \& Governance Lead** to drive end\-to\-end cloud transformation, technical governance, DevSecOps adoption, platform security, and FinOps optimization. In this role, you will act as a strategic bridge between Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Operations, Information Security, and Business units to deliver scalable, resilient, and cost\-efficient cloud solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cloud Architecture \& Migration Strategy**

* Perform application architecture assessments, current\-state evaluations, and cloud\-readiness analyses.
* Design target\-state cloud architectures (AWS/Azure/GCP) incorporating IaaS, PaaS, and Serverless paradigms aligned with enterprise standards.
* Conduct solution design reviews focusing on high availability, disaster recovery (HA/DR), scalability, and security.
* Formulate hosting recommendations and migration strategies (Rehost, Re\-platform, Refactor).
* Develop detailed cloud cost estimations, TCO analyses, and financial modeling for cloud deployments.

**Architecture \& Operational Governance**

* Establish and maintain architecture governance aligned with industry\-standard readiness frameworks.
* Provide strategic oversight and governance to Cloud Operations teams.
* Oversee enterprise domain management, routing policies, traffic management, and failover configurations to ensure secure external application exposure.

**DevSecOps \& Platform Onboarding**

* Lead enterprise\-wide DevSecOps onboarding programs for application teams.
* Drive the adoption of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and standardize onboarding prerequisites (Git repositories, infrastructure components, deployment workflows).
* Embed security\-first development practices and automated guardrails directly into delivery pipelines.
* Track and report operational metrics, including onboarding progress, deployment success rates, and vulnerability remediation times.

**FinOps \& Cost Optimization**

* Establish FinOps governance models, resource tagging standards, budgeting, and cost forecasting frameworks across cloud platforms.
* Execute cost\-saving strategies utilizing Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, right\-sizing, and automated resource parking.
* Conduct periodic zero\-based cost reviews and optimization workshops to eliminate cloud waste.
* Instill a culture of proactive cost management throughout the solution design and software delivery lifecycle.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, or Cloud Architecture

**Technical Expertise**

* **Cloud Platforms:** Deep expertise in public cloud platforms (**AWS preferred**; Azure/GCP beneficial).
* **Architecture Patterns:** Advanced knowledge of cloud\-native design, microservices, containerization, and serverless architectures.

 Amazon, Google CI/CD tool suites; IaaS, PaaS, SaaS tool suites; other tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, InSpec, Jenkins, GitHub/BitBucket, Artifactory, Maven, Docker \& Kubernetes, etc.

f66d6733.description:
**TBM / FinOps Implementation Consultant** 




  





**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Full\-time, in\-office
 



**Department:** 
 Implementation / Customer Success / Solutions
 



**Experience:** 
 5\+ years
 



  





**About Yarken** 




  





 Yarken is an AI\-first TBM and FinOps platform helping enterprises gain visibility, control, and intelligence across technology, cloud, software, and operational spend.
 



 Our platform brings together technology financial management, cloud cost governance, allocation, chargeback/showback, reporting, and AI\-driven insights so Finance, IT, Cloud, and business leaders can make faster, better decisions.
 



  





 We are looking for a hands\-on TBM / FinOps Implementation Consultant to join our Hyderabad team and help global customers implement, configure, and adopt the Yarken platform.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 This is a customer\-facing implementation role for someone who understands TBM, FinOps, cloud cost management, IT financial management, allocation models, data mapping, and enterprise reporting.
 



 You will work closely with customers, product, engineering, and customer success teams to configure the platform, onboard customer data, define allocation logic, support chargeback/showback models, and help customers get value from Yarken.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys implementation, configuration, data problem\-solving, and working directly with customers to turn messy technology spend data into clear, usable insights.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  





**Implementation \& Configuration** 




  




* Configure the Yarken platform based on customer requirements, workflows, reporting needs, and business objectives.
* Support end\-to\-end implementation activities across TBM, FinOps, ITFM, cloud cost, and technology spend use cases.
* Work with customer data including GL, cloud billing, labor, assets, applications, services, projects, cost centers, vendors, and business units.
* Build and validate allocation, chargeback, and showback models.
* Support tagging, cost categorization, mapping, and data transformation activities.
* Validate reports, dashboards, and outputs before customer review.



  





**Customer \& Stakeholder Support** 




  




* Work with customer teams across Finance, IT, Cloud, Procurement, Engineering, and Operations.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into configuration and implementation steps.
* Support workshops, onboarding sessions, implementation reviews, and adoption discussions.
* Explain implementation logic clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Help customers identify cost visibility, governance, optimization, and reporting opportunities.



  





**Data, Reporting \& Governance** 




  




* Analyze customer data quality issues and support remediation.
* Work with cloud cost data from AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Support FinOps reporting, cloud cost allocation, tagging governance, and cost optimization analysis.
* Support TBM reporting across towers, services, applications, projects, business units, and cost centers.
* Document configuration logic, mapping rules, implementation decisions, and repeatable playbooks.



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




  




* Partner with Product and Engineering to clarify requirements, validate edge cases, and improve platform capabilities.
* Work with Customer Success to improve adoption and value realization.
* Support Sales and Solutions teams during demos, pilots, and proof\-of\-concepts when needed.
* Share customer feedback that can improve workflows, reports, integrations, automation, and AI\-driven capabilities.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  




* 5\+ years of experience in TBM, FinOps, ITFM, cloud cost management, technology finance, or related implementation roles.
* Hands\-on experience with platforms such as Apptio TBM, Cloudability, CloudHealth, Flexera, ServiceNow, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of cost allocation, chargeback, showback, cloud cost reporting, and technology spend governance.
* Experience working with enterprise customer data such as GL, cloud billing, labor, assets, applications, vendors, services, and cost centers.
* Ability to configure platforms, validate outputs, troubleshoot data issues, and explain results clearly.
* Strong working knowledge of Excel and SQL or similar data analysis tools.
* Comfortable working directly with customers and internal product / engineering teams.
* Clear communication, ownership mindset, and ability to work independently in a fast\-moving environment.
* Willingness to work full\-time from the Hyderabad office.



  





**Nice to Have** 




  




* FinOps Certified Practitioner or related certification.
* Experience with Apptio Cost Transparency, Apptio TBM Studio, ApptioOne, Cloudability, or similar platforms.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud billing and cost data.
* Knowledge of TBM taxonomy, ATUM, service costing, application costing, or IT tower reporting.
* Experience with Snowflake, Power BI, Tableau, ServiceNow, Jira, or data transformation workflows.
* Prior consulting, implementation, customer success, or solution delivery experience in enterprise SaaS.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  




* Customers are onboarded efficiently and see clear value from Yarken.
* Implementations are delivered with accurate data, clear allocation logic, and usable reports.
* Chargeback, showback, and FinOps reporting are configured correctly and trusted by customers.
* Customer requirements are translated clearly into platform configuration and product feedback.
* Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams have a strong implementation partner who understands TBM and FinOps deeply.

=========================


Job Type: Permanent

**Level** Manager


We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Fund Solutions team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

The team supports the full operational lifecycle, spanning Fund Accounting, Asset Servicing, Alternative Assets, Fund Solutions, and Shared Services. FSO ensures these services are delivered efficiently, accurately, and in line with regulatory obligations.


Within FSO, the Fund Solutions team drives the design, delivery, and oversight of operational change initiatives—ranging from regulatory\-driven transformations to strategic platform enhancements.

The FA Delivery role within Fund Solutions is responsible for leading the implementation of operational change initiatives, with a strong focus on Fund Accounting, Middle Office and ABOR transformation. This includes delivering solutions that meet client, operational, and product requirements while integrating process improvements, technology upgrades, and regulatory changes.


You will play a key role in driving initiatives to enhance and future\-proof the operating model. This involves close collaboration with upstream teams—including Corporate Actions, Pricing, Reference Data, and the Portfolio Services Group—as well as supporting new fund launches, particularly those requiring tailored solutions outside the standard model.

013257d9.title: Technical Program Manager II
013257d9.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Technical Program Manager II
Who is Mastercard?  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

Overview  

  

Are you a technical program manager who wants to focus on analytic platforms and data needs? Are you passionate about coordinating and clearly communicating across teams while also managing risk and priorities for your team? Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your own professional learning and development?  

  

We are currently seeking a Technical Program Manager for the Clearing Program. You will own the end\-to\-end delivery of engineering projects
  

  

* Responsible for planning, execution, and delivery, from inception to completion, for an existing technology product or program
* Proactively manages the end\-to\-end delivery of engineering work though the engineering team and all dependent organizations
* Reports on progress, ensuring dependencies are covered


Operates between teams and architectures overseeing the gaps between teams, processes, and systems, while removing all blocking issues leading to a successful delivery  

  

Role  

* Plan and manage a group of related technology projects or activities in a coordinated way from inception through successful delivery
* Deep understanding of the design approaches and technologies utilized in your area


Focus on the customer experience, the build and delivery processes and the problems to be solved  

* Work across multiple scrum teams (may be cross\-cutting across products, scrum teams, and/or technologies or work may be vertically focused on a single product or feature set)
* Align dependent organizations and remove/mitigate all blocking issues
* Work directly with external to the organization or external to Mastercard technology providers and customers
* Work with limited guidance, seeking guidance as needed because the product and delivery strategy is defined.
* Deep understanding of the business and technical requirements for the solutions being built
* Understand the needs of the engineers and technical operations teams who have to build, maintain, and operate the system for the life of the system
* Recognize complex designs and propose simplified solutions by working with software design engineers, principals and TPMs
* Help customers and the engineering teams make trade\-off decisions by considering all of the data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability.
* You identify blocking issues and manage their resolution.
* Identify, assess, track and mitigate issues and risks at multiple levels
* Write documentation as required
* Partner with industry vendors that provide technology or user experience design components that support our architecture and work with vendors on our implementation plans and roadmaps identifying partnership opportunities to increase our development velocity and our learnings
* Communicate role up of project issues and status in a concise, accurate, and professional manner for senior leadership consumption, escalating blocking issues when appropriate
* Communicate progress, anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, identify, assess, track and mitigate issues/risks at multiple levels
* Work across teams to optimize processes
* Regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility ensuring your program stays aligned with organization objectives
* Anticipate bottlenecks and adequately factor in contingency for unplanned delays
* Determine if success metrics are in place and if not, you work to define them
* Recognize discordant views and take part in constructive dialog to resolve them
* Continuously assess development processes, test plans, and operations. You work with teams to improve concurrent project delivery.
* Streamline and/or eliminate excess process in any area of the architecture, production operations environment, or business area where the same efforts (or issues) are repeated year\-over\-year

  

All About You  

* Deep understanding of the design approaches, technologies and business drivers in your area
* Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies and methods
* Expert level knowledge of software development processes and Agile practices
* Experience working in a high\-level collaborative environment and promoting a teamwork mentality
* Experience applying analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to predict challenges and seek to proactively head\-off obstacles
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Experience in all things data – writing SQL queries, researching data discrepancies, data reporting
* Strong communications skills \- both verbal and written \- ability to communicate critical points efficient across a wide range of audiences
* You have passion and experience in working on customer facing emerging products and services.
* You have a strong sense of personal accountability regarding decision\-making and supervising scrum teams
* You are results driven with proven ability to effectively define and communicate project status, risks, and solutions in a proactive manner. Also able to manage support issues to drive to root cause and resolution.
* You are high\-energy, detail\-oriented, proactive and adaptive and can work in a dynamic environment.
* You have an ability to simultaneously manage short\-term priorities and long\-term initiatives and have experience working with agile software development processes, ideally as a scrum master.
* You build solid and trust\-based relationships within the team and various stakeholders and become a valued thought partner.
* You can exercise influence outside your own teams to achieve results for the entire organization.
* Expertise in Jira and AI

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

a5ecc7fc.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
a5ecc7fc.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

### **About the Role**

  

We are looking for a highly accomplished Technical Program Manager (TPM) — at the Staff level — to play a pivotal role in spearheading our product development and geographic expansion initiatives. This strategic role requires a deep technical background to effectively partner with product managers and engineering managers, providing technical leadership to own the execution plan and deliver complex, cross\-team engineering initiatives. You will be the champion for predictable and timely delivery, able to take ownership of and drive the mitigation of risks to the program, and skilled in facilitating quantifiable success across diverse engineering and product teams. Your core responsibility is to ensure the predictable delivery of products by actively engaging in technical discussions, identifying and proactively resolving dependencies and technical blockers, mitigating architectural risks, and applying best\-in\-class program management practices.

 **What You'll Do**

### **Technical Strategy \& Planning**

* Drive strategic, cross\-functional planning and prioritization, partnering with Product and Engineering leadership to develop comprehensive program plans, including roadmap definition, dependency mapping, and resourcing models.
* Drive the process of translating high\-level business and product requirements into actionable, concrete engineering tasks, milestones, and technical specifications.
* Contribute to the definition and tracking of effective technical metrics, driving improvements that optimize engineering operating performance and system health.

### **Technical Execution \& Delivery**

* Lead and facilitate regular program\-level meetings and reviews with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure projects achieve successful outcomes.
* Proactively monitor program health, tracking status, risks, issues, and complex technical dependencies across engineering teams.
* Deep dive into technical issues to facilitate resolution, and drive appropriate executive\-level escalations and program\-level change management processes as\-needed.
* Take personal ownership of engineering roadblocks and technical delays, escalating issues appropriately and driving them to timely closure by working directly with engineering leads.

### **Process \& Communication**

* Manage high\-level program communications, ensuring all stakeholders—from delivery teams to executive management—are consistently informed of roadmap changes, release plans, and delivery status, with a clear explanation of technical trade\-offs and risks.
* Establish, document, and champion the adoption of new program frameworks, tools, and best practices across the R\&D organization.
* Act as an agent of change, helping to establish and strengthen the Technical Program Management function across the company.

 **Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of experience as TPM, Engineering Lead, Manager, or equivalent working directly with software engineering teams.
* Proven track record to communicate technical issues effectively to technical and non\-technical partners at different levels of the organization.
* Proven ability to build and implement detailed plans accounting for ambiguity, dependencies, and technical complexity in a fast\-moving environment.
* Demonstrated excellence in the practice of technical program management, especially in establishing TPM processes from scratch.
* Highly skilled in pragmatically identifying, tracking and reporting on cross team dependencies and collaboratively addressing them effectively with providing/receiving teams.
* Demonstrated attention to detail and a hands\-on disposition.
* Excellent problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Outstanding ability to effectively communicate across all levels of the organization from engineers to executives.
* Four\-year Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related degree, or equivalent work experience.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

0c501032.description:
**About Neo4j**
 Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise\-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy\-to\-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
   

  

 Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
   

  

 As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
   

  

**About The Job**
 You will play a critical role in supporting our enterprise customers early in their journey to ensure the absolute success of their architectural foundations. As a key member of the Professional Services team, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production\-ready ecosystem. You will serve as the trusted technical advisor, leading new customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.
   

  

 Sitting at the heart of our customer\-first culture, you will shape tailored onboarding blueprints, orchestrate complex delivery workstreams, and guarantee a predictable, accelerated time‑to‑value. For our fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self‑managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deliver secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a highly technical, customer\-facing role (e.g., Onboarding Engineering, Customer Success Engineering, DevOps/Platform Engineering, or Technical Consulting).
* Hands\-on experience with production workloads in at least one major cloud provider ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Deep technical proficiency in core networking infrastructure, including VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints.
* Proven track record implementing Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) design.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) utilising Terraform, alongside configuration management tools like Ansible.
* Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container environments).
* Hands\-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j) and proficiency in database querying and performance tuning (e.g., Cypher query optimisation).
* Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk) and enterprise data movement frameworks (ETL/CDC platforms).
* Exposure to cloud compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and data residency deployment patterns.


**Responsibilities**
* Lead complex technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to align on success criteria, KPIs, milestones, and mitigation strategies for project risks.
* Guide the instantiation of Neo4j AuraDB environments or self\-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures utilizing private endpoints and IP allow lists.
* Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption\-at\-rest protocols, and enforce least\-privileged access through enterprise SSO and RBAC configurations.
* Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise development teams on Neo4j driver optimization, connection pooling, and retry logic.
* Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools for logs and metrics, while delivering best\-practice workshops on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
* Produce high\-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and a next\-step backlog—to seamlessly transition customers to Professional Services and Cloud Operations teams.
* Synthesise field insights and lessons learned to continuously iterate and optimise Neo4j’s global technical onboarding methodology and frameworks.
