aa41d510.title: Solution Architect - Onboarding
aa41d510.description:
**About Neo4j**
 Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise\-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy\-to\-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
   

  

 Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
   

  

 As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
   

  

**About The Job**
 You will play a critical role in supporting our enterprise customers early in their journey to ensure the absolute success of their architectural foundations. As a key member of the Professional Services team, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production\-ready ecosystem. You will serve as the trusted technical advisor, leading new customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.
   

  

 Sitting at the heart of our customer\-first culture, you will shape tailored onboarding blueprints, orchestrate complex delivery workstreams, and guarantee a predictable, accelerated time‑to‑value. For our fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self‑managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deliver secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a highly technical, customer\-facing role (e.g., Onboarding Engineering, Customer Success Engineering, DevOps/Platform Engineering, or Technical Consulting).
* Hands\-on experience with production workloads in at least one major cloud provider ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Deep technical proficiency in core networking infrastructure, including VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints.
* Proven track record implementing Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) design.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) utilising Terraform, alongside configuration management tools like Ansible.
* Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container environments).
* Hands\-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j) and proficiency in database querying and performance tuning (e.g., Cypher query optimisation).
* Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk) and enterprise data movement frameworks (ETL/CDC platforms).
* Exposure to cloud compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and data residency deployment patterns.


**Responsibilities**
* Lead complex technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to align on success criteria, KPIs, milestones, and mitigation strategies for project risks.
* Guide the instantiation of Neo4j AuraDB environments or self\-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures utilizing private endpoints and IP allow lists.
* Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption\-at\-rest protocols, and enforce least\-privileged access through enterprise SSO and RBAC configurations.
* Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise development teams on Neo4j driver optimization, connection pooling, and retry logic.
* Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools for logs and metrics, while delivering best\-practice workshops on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
* Produce high\-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and a next\-step backlog—to seamlessly transition customers to Professional Services and Cloud Operations teams.
* Synthesise field insights and lessons learned to continuously iterate and optimise Neo4j’s global technical onboarding methodology and frameworks.

088fc25b.title: Solution Engineer (Post Sales)
088fc25b.description:
**Hevo Data** 




**Solution Engineer (Post\-sales)** 




**About Hevo** 




 DoorDash, Footlocker, Arhaus, Santander, and thousands of other data\-driven companies have one thing in common. They all use Hevo Data’s fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc.
 



 We are a San Francisco, Bangalore, and Pune\-based company with 2000\+ customers spread across 45\+ countries in e\-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, we have raised $42 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper\-growth!
 



**Why do we exist?** 




 At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data\-driven. We started on this journey 9 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”.
 



 Hevo Pipeline is a no\-code platform that helps companies connect all their sources of data within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150\+ data sources such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising Channels, etc.
 



 Today, we enable close to 2000 companies across more than 40\+ countries to be more data\-driven. Our aim is to make the technology so simple that anyone should be able to solve their data problems and not be limited due to their lack of technical skills.
 



**The Role** 




 We are growing into mid\-market and enterprise accounts where the technical bar \- and the stakes \- are higher. To win and retain these customers, we are building the technical depth in our post\-sale motion to match.
 



 Enterprise buyers are not just buying a product. They are making architectural decisions. The CTOs, data architects, and engineering leads we work with at this level need a technical counterpart.
 



 As a Solution Engineer, you are that person. You are not the first point of contact, and you are not handling tickets.
 



 You are the expert our Account Managers bring in when a customer conversation goes beyond relationship management \- a quarterly architecture review, a complex integration challenge, a strategic expansion decision, or simply when a CTO wants to talk to someone who really knows data.
 



**What You Will Do** 



* Be the senior technical specialist that Account Managers call on for complex customer conversations \- architecture reviews, expansion discussions, and senior\-level technical engagements.
* Engage credibly with CTOs, senior engineers, and data architects as a genuine thought partner: understand their architecture, challenge assumptions, co\-design pipelines, and offer a credible point of view.
* Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise customers evaluating new use cases, migrations, or architectural changes involving Hevo.
* Translate complex customer requirements into actionable guidance \- both for the customer and, where needed, and for Hevo's internal engineering team.
* Build and maintain deep expertise in the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses, orchestration, transformation, and the broader ecosystem Hevo operates within.
* Identify expansion opportunities through technical engagement and hand them off to the AM with enough context to move the conversation forward commercially.
* Contribute to internal knowledge \- documenting patterns, building reference architectures, and raising the technical bar across the post\-sales team.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Required** 



* 6\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role \- Solutions Engineering, Data Engineering, or a technical post\-sale or consulting function.
* Deep, broad knowledge of data engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), orchestration, and the modern data stack.
* Hands\-on experience with data integration tools, CDC, event streaming, or warehouse\-native transformation (dbt, etc.).
* Demonstrable ability to engage at the architectural level \- not just explain a product, but understand and speak to a customer's data infrastructure.
* Strong communication skills: you can make complex technical ideas clear to both engineers and executives, and you are confident pushing back when a customer's approach is suboptimal.
* Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment with a small team and high autonomy.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in a pre\-sales or post\-sales SE role at a data infrastructure or SaaS company.
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, compliance, or security requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth B2B SaaS environment.



  





**What You Will Not Be Doing** 




 This is not a support role, a ticket\-handling role, or a general customer success role. You will not be measured on ticket volume or response SLAs. You will be measured on whether enterprise customers trust Hevo at the technical level \- and whether that trust translates into deeper, longer, larger relationships.
 



**What We Offer** 



* Competitive compensation and/or equity.
* Direct access to leadership and real influence on how the post\-sale function is built.
* A collaborative, high\-trust environment where technical depth is valued and rewarded.

OsbIndia (OSBI) is an offshore subsidiary of OSB Group. OSBI was incorporated in 2004 as a key part of the OSB Group’s business strategy to provide operational service support. 1\. Job Purpose
  
The Data Architect role is a vital role in Group that wants to align its business goals and needs with IT services, products, software, and infrastructure.
  
  

In this role, you will have the opportunity to create data architecture solutions to solve business challenges. A data architect is responsible for designing and managing data systems and architecture primarily on Microsoft Azure. The job involves working closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and other IT professionals to ensure the effective storage, processing, and analysis of data.
  
  

2\. Core Responsibilities
  
* Architect and design end\-to\-end data solutions on\-premises and in Azure, ensuring alignment with business goals and requirements.
* Provide data architecture support and guidance for new software / solutions
* Create robust and scalable data models that meet business needs while following industry best practices.
* Work with business analysts, data engineers, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements.
* Integrate various data sources (on\-premises, cloud\-based, and third\-party) into the Azure environment.
* Utilise Azure services like Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL Database, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure Databricks for data storage, transformation, and analysis.
* Ensure data security, privacy, and compliance with relevant regulations (GDPR, Basel etc.).
* Implement metadata management and lineage tracking to understand data flow across the architecture.
* Consider data quality and take corrective actions when necessary.
* Optimise data storage and retrieval strategies to improve performance and reduce costs.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues with data pipelines and data access.
* Solution design which may range from new ETL functionality or ETL configuration, Relational or Dimensional Data Modelling.
* Collaborate with other teams like data engineers, analysts, and business intelligence teams to ensure data architecture is suitable for reporting and analytics needs.
* Create and maintain detailed documentation of data architecture, data models, and technical solutions.
* Keep up with the latest Azure updates and emerging technologies.
* Continuously improve the architecture based on feedback, evolving requirements, and technological advancements.
* Help maintain and support gradual decommissioning of on\-prem SQL databases and data warehouse eco system.


•
  
•
  
  

3\. Experience Requirements
  
* Proven experience as a Data Architect or similar role with strong expertise in Azure\-based data solutions working within a regulated environment is essential
* Experience working with Azure data services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, and Azure Blob Storage is essential
* Experience with data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, and cloud\-native data processing frameworks is essential
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data security practices, and cloud data architecture best practices is essential
* Experience in big data technologies such as Databricks, Kafka, and data lakes is essential

We understand your career and how you progress is as unique as your individual personality. baa85a0c.description:
Principal AI \& Data Architect – Enterprise Data Platform (AI, Analytics \& GenAI)  

Role Summary: We are seeking a Senior AI \& Data Platform Architect with deep expertise in Azure Databricks, Snowflake, cloud\-scale data engineering, Lakehouse architecture, and enterprise analytics platforms. In this role, you will define, design, and govern enterprise\-scale data processing, analytics, and AI\-ready platform solutions across Azure Databricks and Snowflake. You will lead architectural decisions across multiple initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives, cloud strategy, security, performance, scalability, reliability, governance, and cost optimization standards.  

The ideal candidate will combine strong hands\-on architecture experience, platform engineering mindset, stakeholder leadership, and the ability to guide delivery teams on modern data platform implementation patterns. This role will be accountable for designing end\-to\-end Databricks and Snowflake solutions, establishing architecture standards, reviewing solution designs, mentoring senior engineers, and improving overall data platform maturity across the organization.  

Roles \& Responsibilities  

* Act as the architecture lead and subject matter expert for Azure Databricks, Snowflake, and enterprise data platform initiatives across projects and programs.
* Analyze business, data, functional, and non\-functional requirements and translate them into scalable end\-to\-end architecture designs.
* Design modern data lakehouse and data warehouse architectures using Azure Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Factory.
* Define and govern medallion architecture standards across raw, curated, and serving layers, including bronze, silver, and gold data patterns.
* Architect scalable ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and consumption patterns across batch, incremental, near\-real\-time, and streaming workloads.
* Define Databricks cluster architecture, job design, workflow orchestration, notebook standards, and workload isolation strategies.
* Design Snowflake warehouse strategies, data modelling patterns, workload management, query optimization, cost controls, and secure data sharing approaches.
* Establish reusable reference architectures, solution patterns, guardrails, and engineering standards for Databricks, Snowflake, and AI\-ready data products.
* Drive performance optimization, scalability, resiliency, and cost efficiency through cluster tuning, SQL optimization, resource management, and platform monitoring.
* Define data security and governance practices including RBAC, ABAC, secrets management, encryption, row\-level and column\-level access, masking, lineage, and compliance controls.
* Review solution designs, notebooks, SQL assets, pipelines, infrastructure templates, and deployment approaches for architectural compliance.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, data governance, platform operations, analytics, and business stakeholders on key design decisions.
* Guide CI/CD, DevOps, and release management strategies for Databricks and Snowflake deployments using Git\-based workflows and automated promotion patterns.
* Provide architectural guidance during production incidents, root cause analysis, platform optimization, capacity planning, and operational maturity initiatives.
* Mentor technical leads, senior data engineers, and platform engineers through architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, and best\-practice enablement.


Professional \& Technical Skills – Must Have  

* Strong hands\-on and architectural experience with Azure Databricks, including cluster configuration, cluster policies, job scheduling, workflow orchestration, notebook design, and workload optimization.
* Advanced expertise in Apache Spark architecture, PySpark, Spark SQL, Spark performance tuning, partitioning, caching, shuffle optimization, and scalable data processing patterns.
* Deep understanding of Delta Lake, Delta tables, schema evolution, time travel, optimization, vacuuming, and lakehouse reliability patterns.
* Strong proficiency in SQL for data transformations, data modeling, analytics workloads, and performance tuning.
* Strong experience with Snowflake architecture, including virtual warehouses, resource monitors, workload isolation, Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, Snowpark, secure data sharing, cloning, and Time Travel.
* Experience designing scalable data models across lakehouse, data warehouse, dimensional, Data Vault, semantic, and consumption\-oriented architectures.
* Deep understanding of data engineering, data warehousing, ELT/ETL, metadata management, orchestration, and data quality frameworks.
* Experience implementing secure, scalable, governed, and AI\-ready data platforms using Azure Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, and modern cloud\-native services.
* Strong knowledge of Azure cloud security, identity, access control, networking, private endpoints, secrets management, and governance controls.
* Experience defining CI/CD and deployment strategies for Databricks notebooks, jobs, workflows, libraries, infrastructure\-as\-code, and Snowflake database objects.
* Ability to evaluate architectural trade\-offs across performance, cost, scalability, maintainability, security, reliability, and delivery speed.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to influence enterprise architects, security teams, platform teams, engineering teams, and senior stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications  

* Experience designing enterprise\-scale data platforms that support analytics, reporting, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic AI use cases.
* Exposure to Unity Catalog, catalog design, data ownership models, metadata management, lineage, and governance operating models.
* Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Snowpark, external functions, vector search, semantic search, or AI\-enabled analytics capabilities is preferred.
* Experience integrating Databricks and Snowflake with BI, ML, MLOps, LLMOps, data catalog, observability, and enterprise monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of streaming and event\-driven architectures using Kafka, Event Hubs, structured streaming, Snowpipe Streaming, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with platform modernization, migration from legacy data warehouses, cloud data lake implementation, or large\-scale data product enablement.
* Familiarity with cost optimization practices across Databricks compute, Snowflake warehouses, storage tiers, orchestration, and consumption workloads.
* Relevant certifications such as Databricks Data Engineer Professional, Databricks Solutions Architect, SnowPro Core, SnowPro Advanced Architect, or Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect are desirable.


Additional Information  

* The candidate should have 9–12 years of experience in data engineering, analytics, big data platforms, or cloud data architecture, with clear architecture ownership across enterprise initiatives.
* This position is based at Bengaluru, Chennai, or Hyderabad office locations.
* Minimum 15 years of full\-time education or equivalent qualification is required.
* The role is responsible for driving architecture governance, technical standards, platform scalability, platform stability, cost optimization, and engineering maturity across multiple teams.
* The architect will be accountable for enabling robust, secure, high\-performance, and governed Databricks and Snowflake solutions aligned to enterprise data and AI strategy.


Key Success Measures  

* Enterprise architecture standards for Databricks and Snowflake are defined, communicated, and adopted across delivery teams.
* Data pipelines and analytics workloads are scalable, secure, performant, cost\-efficient, and aligned with governance requirements.
* Reusable platform patterns, medallion architecture standards, CI/CD practices, and deployment guardrails improve delivery consistency.
* Production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and platform risks are reduced through proactive design reviews and operational governance.
* Senior engineers and technical leads are mentored to improve architecture quality, platform maturity, and engineering excellence.
 **Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**  

Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

331c5f32.description:
**About us:**  

OsbIndia (OSBI) is an offshore subsidiary of OSB Group. OSBI was incorporated in 2004 as a key part of the OSB Group’s business strategy to provide operational service support. OSBI works with the Group’s trading brands in the UK, providing exceptional customer support and service delivery to new and existing customers.
  
  

OSBI also prides itself on offering operational excellence by devising and utilizing process improvements and functional efficiencies.
  
  

1\. Job Purpose
  
The Data Delivery Manager will have delivery responsibility for pieces of Data Office work while also having a wider Data Office role of assisting the Head of Data Delivery in ensuring that Data Office resources are managed against demand across the data teams.
  
From a delivery perspective the Data Delivery Manager will work with both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, the Data Office will be moving to predominately Agile, but some Waterfall will persist. The Data Delivery Manager will lead pieces of Data Office work either by providing delivery management to the Scrum Masters or directly to some of the Data Engineers / Senior Data Engineers.
  
From a wider Data Office resourcing and delivery perspective the role will operate across the Data Office, working with the Head of Data Delivery and the other members of the leadership team to ensure that resources are correctly allocated and projects and programmes are tracking to their deliverables.
  
The Data Delivery Manager role is a functional role as opposed to a hands\-on technical role, from time to time, the role may provide direct line management to some other members of the Data Delivery Team.
  
Therefore, the Data Delivery Manager role will encompass all aspects of delivery management, team management and leadership covering:
  
* Team, Delivery \& Scrum Management
* Resource Planning \& Allocation
* Stakeholder Management (up to Director level)
* Team process development and adherence to standards
* Risk assessment and issue resolution
* Representation of the Data Office team in senior forums / discussions e.g. Steering Groups, Project Boards, Change Boards
* Provision of reporting covering Data Office work and performance
* Mentoring other data delivery professionals (particularly in Agile)


The role will require an appreciation and high\-level understanding of data architectures, and of the design and delivery of data transformations and visualisations. The successful candidate will need to work flexibly with a varied workload in an environment which is vibrant and dynamic.
  
The role reports to the Head of Data Delivery in UK (with Line Manager reporting to Senior Manager Data Operations at OSBI, Bengaluru) and will need to work closely with other members of the data leadership team.
  
  

2\. Core Responsibilities
  
* To lead delivery of pieces of Data Office work using Agile or Waterfall methodologies.
* Occasional line management support to other members of the Data Delivery team when required in the absence of the Senior Data Delivery Manager.
* To undertake Data Office Resource Planning and Allocation that covers all aspects of the Data Office.
* From a Project perspective actively work with the Change Delivery Programme and Project Managers to understand the forth coming project demand and then help ensure that Data Office resources are allocated to the projects in a timely manner.
* Work closely with the Change Delivery teams, representing the Data Office and ensuring that the plans derived are deliverable from a Data Office viewpoint.
* Actively work with the Change Delivery Programme and Project Managers to ensure delivery timelines are adhered to, delivery risks are managed and any blocking delivery issues are resolved in a timely manner.
* Be a point of contact for the Data Office and then during delivery to be a point of escalation for data issues / problems.
* To provide proactive Stakeholder Management (up to Director level) to all parties impacted by / working with the Data Office, providing advice and guidance as requested, and always representing the Data Office in a positive and proactive way.
* Forge effective working relationships across the wider IT team, Change Delivery and the Business to aid the delivery of data solutions and to help shape and drive the Data Office across the organisation.
* Represent the Data Office in senior forums / discussions e.g. Steering Groups, Project Boards, Change Boards
* Work closely with the Head of Data Delivery and other members of the leadership team to drive the Strategy for the Data Office.
* Derive and provide reporting covering Data Office work and performance.
* Assist with Data Office recruitment activities, helping to review CVs and conduct interviews.
* To play an active role in the IT management community, providing support and help to other IT management colleagues as requested / required.
* To provide delivery mentoring and guidance to other data delivery professionals, particularly in Agile.
* Ensure that you fully understand and comply with the organisation’s Risk Management Policies as they relate to your area of responsibility and demonstrate in your day\-to\-day work that you put customers at the heart of everything you do.
* Ensure that you fully understand and comply with the organisation’s Data Governance Policies as they relate to your area of responsibility and demonstrate in your day\-to\-day work that you treat data as an important corporate asset which must be protected and managed.
* Maintain the company’s compliance standards and ensure timely completion of all mandatory on\-line training modules and attestations.
* Ensure that you keep your professional knowledge up to date to comply with the Knowledge and Competence requirements of the Mortgage Credit Directive.


3\. Experience Requirements
  
* 10\+ years previous experience of managing a multi\-site IT team is essential, preferable within the Financial Services Industry.
* 8\+ years previous experience of IT software delivery management experience is essential, preferably on Data projects.
* 5 years previous experience in managing multiple stakeholders at different levels of seniority is essential.
* 5 years previous experience of IT process development, management, developing technical roadmaps and strategy is essential.
* 5 years previous experience of working in formal change and project management processes as well as working in a formal release process is essential.
* 5 years previous experience of resource planning, management and allocation is essential.
* 5 years previous experience of undertaking recruitment, interview and selection activities is desirable.


Why join OSBI?
  
  

We understand your career and how you progress is as unique as your individual personality. We've created a culture and an environment that encourages personal growth and offers our people opportunities to learn and succeed. Whether you're in the early stages of your career or already have an established profession, we're constantly seeking to hire talented individuals who want to make a difference and grow with us. We're a connected company working together to create a business in which we can all take pride and prosper.

To know more about OSBI culture please find us on Instagram @OSBINDIA

Therefore, the Data Delivery Manager role will encompass all aspects of delivery management, team management and leadership covering:
  
* Team, Delivery \& Scrum Management
* Resource Planning \& Allocation
* Stakeholder Management (up to Director level)
* Team process development and adherence to standards
* Risk assessment and issue resolution
* Representation of the Data Office team in senior forums / discussions e.g. Steering Groups, Project Boards, Change Boards
* Provision of reporting covering Data Office work and performance
* Mentoring other data delivery professionals (particularly in Agile)


The role will require an appreciation and high\-level understanding of data architectures, and of the design and delivery of data transformations and visualisations. The successful candidate will need to work flexibly with a varied workload in an environment which is vibrant and dynamic.
  
The role reports to the Head of Data Delivery in UK (with Line Manager reporting to Senior Manager Data Operations at OSBI, Bengaluru) and will need to work closely with other members of the data leadership team.
  
  

2\. Core Responsibilities
  
* To lead delivery of pieces of Data Office work using Agile or Waterfall methodologies.
* Occasional line management support to other members of the Data Delivery team when required in the absence of the Senior Data Delivery Manager.
* To undertake Data Office Resource Planning and Allocation that covers all aspects of the Data Office.
* From a Project perspective actively work with the Change Delivery Programme and Project Managers to understand the forth coming project demand and then help ensure that Data Office resources are allocated to the projects in a timely manner.
* Work closely with the Change Delivery teams, representing the Data Office and ensuring that the plans derived are deliverable from a Data Office viewpoint.
* Actively work with the Change Delivery Programme and Project Managers to ensure delivery timelines are adhered to, delivery risks are managed and any blocking delivery issues are resolved in a timely manner.
* Be a point of contact for the Data Office and then during delivery to be a point of escalation for data issues / problems.
* To provide proactive Stakeholder Management (up to Director level) to all parties impacted by / working with the Data Office, providing advice and guidance as requested, and always representing the Data Office in a positive and proactive way.
* Forge effective working relationships across the wider IT team, Change Delivery and the Business to aid the delivery of data solutions and to help shape and drive the Data Office across the organisation.
* Represent the Data Office in senior forums / discussions e.g. Steering Groups, Project Boards, Change Boards
* Work closely with the Head of Data Delivery and other members of the leadership team to drive the Strategy for the Data Office.
* Derive and provide reporting covering Data Office work and performance.
* Assist with Data Office recruitment activities, helping to review CVs and conduct interviews.
* To play an active role in the IT management community, providing support and help to other IT management colleagues as requested / required.
* To provide delivery mentoring and guidance to other data delivery professionals, particularly in Agile.
* Ensure that you fully understand and comply with the organisation’s Risk Management Policies as they relate to your area of responsibility and demonstrate in your day\-to\-day work that you put customers at the heart of everything you do.
* Ensure that you fully understand and comply with the organisation’s Data Governance Policies as they relate to your area of responsibility and demonstrate in your day\-to\-day work that you treat data as an important corporate asset which must be protected and managed.
* Maintain the company’s compliance standards and ensure timely completion of all mandatory on\-line training modules and attestations.
* Ensure that you keep your professional knowledge up to date to comply with the Knowledge and Competence requirements of the Mortgage Credit Directive.


3\. Experience Requirements
  
* 10\+ years previous experience of managing a multi\-site IT team is essential, preferable within the Financial Services Industry.
* 8\+ years previous experience of IT software delivery management experience is essential, preferably on Data projects.
* 5 years previous experience in managing multiple stakeholders at different levels of seniority is essential.
* 5 years previous experience of IT process development, management, developing technical roadmaps and strategy is essential.
* 5 years previous experience of working in formal change and project management processes as well as working in a formal release process is essential.
* 5 years previous experience of resource planning, management and allocation is essential.
* 5 years previous experience of undertaking recruitment, interview and selection activities is desirable.

8588ca83.title: Product Owner/ Delivery Manager
8588ca83.description:
About the Role
 



 We are looking for a senior, hands\-on Product Owner / Delivery Manager who takes end\-to\-end responsibility for product features, from ideation through build, release, and live operation.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role combining:
 



  




* **Product Management**
* **Product Ownership**
* **Delivery \& Release Management**



  





 The role sits close to the CTO Office and acts as the single point of accountability for product execution, timelines, quality, and stakeholder communication.
 



 You will plan, drive, and run releases, own the product roadmap, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and provide clear delivery reporting to leadership.
 



 The ideal candidate will be hands\-on, execution\-focused, and comfortable working in an Agile/Scrum environment, with strong ownership of delivery, quality, timelines, and stakeholder communication.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**End\-to\-End Product \& Feature Ownership** 



* Own product features from concept → delivery → post\-release support
* Translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Take full accountability for scope, timelines, quality, and outcomes
* Balance new features, technical work, and fixes based on priority and impact








**Delivery \& Release Management** 



* Act as Delivery Manager for product initiatives and releases
* Plan, schedule, and run software releases end\-to\-end
* Coordinate engineering, QA, design, and business teams to ensure readiness
* Lead UAT planning and execution, including go/no\-go decisions
* Manage live issues, defects, and hotfixes in coordination with engineering
* Ensure predictable delivery through strong planning and execution discipline



  
 



**Product Ownership (Agile / Scrum)** 



* Act as Product Owner for one or more development teams
* Own, prioritise, and continuously groom the product backlog (Jira)
* Lead sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
* Ensure Agile/Scrum processes are followed with a strong delivery mindset
* Handle defect triage, prioritisation, and resolution tracking



  
 



**Roadmap \& Prioritisation** 



* Own and maintain the product roadmap
* Drive prioritisation decisions based on business value, urgency, and feasibility
* Align roadmap delivery with company goals and leadership expectations
* Clearly communicate trade\-offs and sequencing decisions



  
 



**Stakeholder \& CTO Office Support** 



* Act as a bridge between leadership, stakeholders, and delivery teams
* Provide clear delivery reporting: progress, risks, dependencies, and timelines
* Support the CTO Office with execution tracking and delivery visibility
* Drive continuous improvements in product, delivery, and release processes
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in delivery plans and outcomes



  
 



**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* Senior experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Delivery Manager
* Proven ownership of end\-to\-end product delivery and software releases
* Strong Agile/Scrum expertise with hands\-on Jira usage
* Experience running UAT, release coordination, and live production support
* Excellent stakeholder communication and expectation management
* Comfortable managing multiple workstreams in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong sense of ownership — you drive things to completion



  
 



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience working closely with a CTO or leadership team
* Background in scaling products or managing multiple concurrent releases
* Experience in SaaS, platform, or complex multi\-team environments



  
 



**What This Role Is (and Is Not)** 



* Owns delivery end\-to\-end
* Plans and runs releases
* Drives roadmap and prioritisation
* Accountable for outcomes, not just tickets
* Not a passive backlog manager
* Not a junior PO
* Not a purely strategic role without execution ownership

3ca4efc1.description:
Experience Level: 5 to 7 Years
 



 Location: Pune
 



  





**Role Description:** 




 The Technical Client Partner owns the end\-to\-end client relationship and technical project delivery for North American enterprise accounts. They bridge the gap between business goals and engineering execution. They manage client stakeholders, drive revenue growth, deliver high\-impact demos, and ensure technical teams deliver high\-quality, scalable AI/ML and cloud solutions on time and within budget.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Client Engagement \& Presentation** 



* **North American Account Ownership:** 
 Serve as the primary, trusted technical point of contact for enterprise clients
* **Presentations \& Demos:** 
 Deliver high\-impact, persuasive live demonstrations and technical pitches to client decision\-makers, validating engineering feasibility and modern cloud capabilities.
* **AI/ML Value Translation:** 
 Translate complex AI/ML mechanics into clear business value propositions. Explain the direct return on investment (ROI) of predictive models and Generative AI pipelines.



**Technical Delivery Oversight** 



* **AI \& Cloud Delivery:** 
 Lead cross\-functional engineering, product, and QA teams to successfully deliver complex enterprise web/mobile apps, serverless architectures, and generative AI pipelines.
* **Milestone Ownership:** 
 Manage agile sprint cadences, track technical deliverables, and proactively clear project roadblocks.
* **Account Engineering:** 
 Partner with technical leads to design scalable, production\-grade solutions that fit client budgets.



**Value Realization \& Metrics** 



* **Success Metric Tracking:** 
 Define, monitor, and report on key implementation success metrics (e.g., system latency, model accuracy, business process automation efficiency, and infrastructure cost reductions).
* **Value Reviews:** 
 Conduct formal value\-delivery presentations back to the client's executive sponsors to justify ongoing investments and prove system performance against initial benchmarks.



**Growth \& Farming** 



* **Account Farming:** 
 Identify opportunities within existing accounts for modernizing legacy systems using AI/ML or cloud tech, driving account expansion, and leading scope and contract negotiations.



**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 



* **Experience:** 
 5\+ years managing technical software delivery or serving as a client\-facing technical lead, with at least 2 years managing North American enterprise accounts.
* **AI/ML Literacy:** 
 Understanding of LLMs, data engineering pipelines, MLOps, and model training vs. inference costs.
* **Cloud Architecture:** 
 Familiarity with modern cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), and serverless.
* **Enterprise App Dev:** 
 Experience delivering secure, compliant, multi\-tenant enterprise software solutions under Agile, Scrum, and DevOps frameworks.
* **Communication \& Analysis:** 
 Masterful presentation and negotiation skills, with a strong analytical mindset to construct value frameworks and measure KPIs for non\-technical executives.
* **Business Acumen:** 
 Experience managing project P\&L, SOWs (Statements of Work), and client contract renewals.



**What Success Looks Like** 



* **Predictable Delivery:** 
 Shipping complex AI and cloud features smoothly without project scope creep, while keeping client satisfaction scores (CSAT/NPS) high and churn low.
* **Trust \& Retention:** 
 Becoming the trusted technical sounding board for the client's engineering leadership, ensuring they clearly understand and visually witness the impact of their AI investments.
* **Expansion:** 
 Delivering technical demos that successfully expand contract scope or secure project expansions, resulting in measurable year\-over\-year revenue growth.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.

 **Overview**


As a Service Delivery Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing the OSM Projects. The operational service delivery is a vital element of our overall Experience as a Service promise and is offered to our key customers.

Your team’s projects will cut across time zones, clients, and technologies and it is your job to motivate, allocate work, manage execution, and communicate to senior stakeholders.
   

  

 At NielsenIQ, we empower our Program Leads to drive results and change. If you thrive in high\-energy environments and if you love the idea of working across every business function, you would be a great fit for our team!
   

  





**RESPONSIBILITIES:**



* Drive the end\-to\-end execution of program deliverables and tracking of program health
* Define and track program milestones, timelines, and deployment plans
* Provide coaching to a team of up to 2\-3 project managers
* Manage program scope (demand intake, documentation, change control, communication)
* Act as the face of the program and communicate progress to upper management and stakeholders
* Act as liaison for all facets of the program and pull people together to make decisions (Product, Operations, Technology, Commercial, Data Science, Client Deployment, Marketing, Sales) throughout the project
* Facilitate cross\-team prioritization between Stakeholders and Technology teams in order to create release plans and continue to manage throughout the program lifecycle

27d6d450.description:
Technical Architect**Ready to turn bold ideas into real\-world impact?**  

 At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry\-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large\-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.  

  

If you thrive in a fast\-moving, innovation\-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting\-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment.  

  

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  

 Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**


As a T1 Technical Architect – MuleSoft \& Solace, you will be our hands\-on specialist for API\-led connectivity and event\-driven integration. Reporting to the P1 Technical Architect Manager, you will work closely with senior T2 architects to design, build, test, and maintain our global application interfaces and event mesh networks. Using MuleSoft and Solace PubSub\+, you will connect our internal enterprise applications (such as SAP S/4HANA) with cloud services, regional platforms, and commercial partners, ensuring real\-time, highly reliable, and secure data flows.

 **The Five Principles in Action for This Role**

* **Quality:** You will build and test precise API specifications (RAML/OAS), robust Mule flows, and Solace event schemas that protect the integrity of our enterprise data. Your extreme attention to detail ensures that millions of messages, transactions, and event payloads route cleanly through our global ecosystem without bottlenecks or data loss.
* **Responsibility:** You will own the day\-to\-day stability, performance, and health of our MuleSoft and Solace integration lines. When automated workflows or real\-time event streams hit technical bottlenecks, you take immediate personal ownership to investigate, patch, and restore standard operations.
* **Mutuality:** In a CPG business, our success is entirely linked to the success of our business segments, retail partners, and external systems. You will design and deploy clear, reliable, and standardized API\-led integrations and event topics that make data sharing simple, painless, and mutually beneficial.
* **Efficiency:** You will combat operational waste by building reusable API templates, shared Mule fragments, and standardized event schemas. By minimizing redundant integrations and leveraging pub/sub messaging patterns, you help the business scale digital products with maximum speed and minimum cost.
* **Freedom:** We support your professional growth and technical curiosity. Guided by our long\-term generational mindset, you are encouraged to propose innovative, modern integration approaches (such as combining real\-time APIs with event\-driven architectures) and explore advanced MuleSoft and Solace platform capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Hands\-On API \& Event\-Driven Development**

* Develop, test, and deploy end\-to\-end APIs, integration flows, and event\-driven patterns using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (Studio, API Manager, CloudHub/RTF) and Solace PubSub\+ (Event Portal, brokers).
* Design and build RAML/OAS API specifications and implement API\-led connectivity architectures (Experience, Process, and System API tiers).
* Configure Solace PubSub\+ message queues, topics, subscriptions, and event mesh networks for high\-throughput, real\-time messaging.
* Build and maintain standard integration points with internal ERP systems—specifically SAP S/4HANA—using SAP Connectors, OData, and modern enterprise integration patterns.

**2\. Platform Integration \& Onboarding**

* Execute technical onboarding and connectivity setup for applications, databases, and third\-party SaaS services entering the API and event mesh networks.
* Conduct performance, load, and end\-to\-end testing of integration flows and event streams to validate low\-latency and reliable message delivery.
* Ensure all MuleSoft APIs and Solace event configurations adhere strictly to global API design standards, security guidelines (OAuth, TLS), and internal architecture blueprints.

**3\. Monitoring, Troubleshooting \& Operations**

* Monitor the health of the MuleSoft and Solace environments, tracking API transaction rates, response times, message queues, and event subscription backlogs.
* Provide rapid Level 2/3 technical support for integration failures, runtime exceptions, API gateway issues, connection drops, and message queue blockages.
* Perform root\-cause analysis (RCA) on persistent runtime issues and implement permanent structural fixes (such as implementing robust error\-handling, caching, or reconnection strategies).
* Help maintain detailed documentation for API contracts, event schema definitions, topology diagrams, and deployment pipelines.

**4\. Technical Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work under the mentorship of T2 Technical Architects to align MuleSoft and Solace designs with the wider Global Integration Hub architecture (such as SAP BTP IS, Azure IS).
* Identify opportunities to migrate legacy point\-to\-point integrations and file transfer protocols to modern, real\-time API or event\-driven patterns.
* Assist in platform maintenance, coordinate runtime patch testing (Mule runtimes, Solace firmware), and manage digital certificates/keys for secure connections.

**Required Experience \& Qualifications**

**Technical Competency \& Platform Expertise**

* **Integration Focus:** 3\+ years of direct, hands\-on experience designing, developing, and managing integration solutions using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (CloudHub/RTF) and/or Solace PubSub\+ (or equivalent enterprise event brokers like Kafka, RabbitMQ, though Solace is highly preferred).
* **API Design \& Standards:** Deep understanding of RESTful API principles, RAML/OAS, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, and XML formats.
* **Messaging \& Event\-Driven Patterns:** Solid experience with pub/sub architectures, message queueing, event\-driven design, JMS, MQTT, AMQP, and Solace event mesh concepts.
* **ERP/System Integration:** Basic to intermediate knowledge of integrating with SAP ERP/S4HANA environments using MuleSoft SAP Connector, IDocs, or RFCs.

**Industry \& Domain Knowledge**

* **CPG/FMCG Familiarity:** Experience working within a fast\-moving consumer goods, retail, or logistics\-heavy business environment.
* **Supply Chain Processes:** Good understanding of standard physical supply chain movements, primarily Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), and warehouse operations (3PL integrations).

**Soft Skills \& Collaboration**

* **Problem\-Solving:** Analytical mindset with a systematic, calm approach to diagnosing system errors and data mismatches.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** Excellent verbal and written skills, with the ability to coordinate technical requirements smoothly with internal and external IT squads.
* **Growth Mindset:** Strong willingness to learn, adapt to new cloud\-based integration trends, and expand skills into adjacent integration technologies (like Azure or SAP BTP).

**Education \& Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or equivalent practical work experience.
* Certifications in MuleSoft (e.g., MuleSoft Certified Developer, MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect) or Solace (e.g., Solace Certified Developer/Architect) are highly regarded.

 **Qualifications**

36b6b2b8.title: Generative AI Forward Deployed Engineer, Google Cloud
36b6b2b8.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in cloud computing or a technical customer\-facing role.
* Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG\-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience taking production\-grade AI\-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
* Experience leading technical discovery sessions.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience implementing multi\-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self\-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
* Knowledge of "LLM\-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost\-per\-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production\-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an "innovator\-builder," moving beyond high\-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high\-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state\-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise\-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real\-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go\-To\-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production\-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi\-agent systems, model context protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable return on investment (ROI).
* Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
* Build high\-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
* Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
* Co\-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google\-grade development best practices, ensuring long\-term project success and high end\-user adoption.

a39f4702.title: Lead System Architect
a39f4702.description:
**Meet Our Team:**
------------------



Our team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high\-quality, outcome\-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team (GTM), you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology.

**Picture Yourself at Pega:**
-----------------------------


*Pega is changing the way the world builds software.* In this role, you’ll help us design, develop, implement and test the next generation customer centric solutions. This is your chance to get your hands\-on leading technology that figures out what people really care about.


At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.


We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

**What You'll Do at Pega:**
---------------------------


* Lead and drive scope definition, requirements analysis, functional and technical design, application build, product configuration, unit testing, UAT and production deployment
* Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle
* Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions
* Collaborating with a high performing Pega delivery team you will ensure the solution meets or exceeds your client’s expectations.
* Provide support and technical governance focused on one or more projects at a single client
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert to the organization and pro\-actively respond to adhoc questions
**Who You Are:**
----------------


* *Pega CLSA Certified resource must.*
* You are a highly technical hands on individual who is passionate about exploring and applying Pega technology to help solve business problems.
* Experience in building and implementing model\-driven, enterprise\-level business solutions.
* Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate

96b047af.title: Solution Architect
96b047af.description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a seasoned Full Stack Solution Architect with strong enterprise solution design experience and deep hands\-on expertise in .NET and AI/ML\-enabled platforms. This role is responsible for defining end\-to\-end architecture for new and existing digital products, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, and guiding delivery across frontend, backend, data, cloud, integration, and machine learning workstreams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end solution architecture for enterprise web, cloud\-native, and AI/ML\-enabled applications across frontend, backend, integrations, data, and infrastructure layers.
* Translate business requirements, user specifications, and stakeholder discussions into architecture blueprints, technical roadmaps, delivery plans, and scalable implementation approaches.
* Define target\-state architectures, roadmaps, standards, timescales, and governance mechanisms to support effective use of technology and digital services.
* Act as design authority and provide architecture assurance, ensuring all architecture deliverables are aligned with organizational standards, policies, security requirements, and strategic goals.
* Drive full lifecycle solution delivery from concept, requirements gathering, specification, design, development, testing, acceptance, deployment, and operational support.
* Design and enable AI/ML\-powered features and platforms, including model selection, data pipelines, feature engineering, inference patterns, deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and optimization.
* Build prototypes and proof of concepts for AI\-enabled capabilities, including model fine\-tuning and production\-readiness assessments.
* Define API contracts, system integration patterns, and technical architecture artifacts for enterprise\-scale applications and services.
* Guide engineering teams on coding standards, reusable frameworks, design patterns, and architectural best practices.
* Establish and maintain standards for CI/CD, automated testing, source code management, containerization, orchestration, observability, and operational readiness.
* Evaluate and select appropriate cloud platforms, managed services, MLOps tools, frameworks, libraries, and third\-party vendor solutions.
* Ensure strong security, privacy, compliance, resilience, and performance optimization across applications, APIs, and ML pipelines.
* Provide leadership in determining and promoting appropriate frameworks, libraries, tools, and engineering approaches used to translate architecture into working code.
* Mentor technical teams, review solution designs and code, lead architecture reviews, and help build new technical capabilities within the team.
* Engage confidently with senior stakeholders, clients, and both technical and non\-technical audiences to explain solution approaches, trade\-offs, and delivery considerations.
* Drive cost optimization, capacity planning, enterprise integration strategy, and support for organizational change and technology adoption.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 13\+ years of software development experience, including significant experience in solution architecture, technical design, and enterprise application delivery.
* Strong hands\-on experience with .NET technologies, including C\#, .NET Framework, .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, MVC, Web API, and Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering full stack solutions spanning backend services, web applications, data platforms, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
* Solid experience with SQL Server and broader data technologies, including SQL/NoSQL databases, ETL, data pipelines, and enterprise data integration.
* Experience with distributed systems, REST APIs, JSON, SOAP, WCF, microservices, SOA, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Hands\-on knowledge of AI/ML concepts and implementation, including building, fine\-tuning, deploying, or integrating machine learning models into production applications.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure and/or AWS, including compute, storage, databases, identity and access management, networking, and managed platform services.
* Experience with DevOps practices and tools, including source control, continuous integration, continuous deployment, automated testing, and release governance.
* Strong understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
* Good knowledge of frontend development with HTML, CSS, HTML5, JavaScript, and at least one modern framework such as Angular, React, or Vue.
* Strong understanding of application security, data privacy, compliance, and performance tuning.
* Excellent documentation, technical proposal writing, presentation, and communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical direction and communicate effectively with clients, leadership, and delivery teams.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with MLOps tools and platforms such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or similar.
* Experience with LLM\-based applications, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and vector databases such as Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, or FAISS.
* Familiarity with high\-throughput, low\-latency architectures and real\-time inference systems.
* Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK.
* Experience with IIS, Mono, ASP.NET MVC vNext, and related Microsoft web ecosystem technologies.
* Knowledge of CRM and collaboration platforms such as SharePoint and Microsoft Dynamics.
* Prior experience in product\-led or SaaS environments and in leading cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Ability to adopt emerging technologies quickly and establish new capabilities within architecture or engineering teams.
* Team mentoring and capability building

1c2bbffb.title: MST Solution Architect
1c2bbffb.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description:** 
 SAP Solution Architect
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced SAP Solution Architect to join our team. As an SAP Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and managing SAP solutions that align with our business goals and technology landscape. This position requires a deep understanding of SAP systems, strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to lead cross\-functional teams in achieving project objectives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Solution Design and Architecture
+ Develop and implement comprehensive SAP solutions that align with business objectives and requirements.
+ Design scalable and sustainable SAP architectures that integrate seamlessly with existing systems and processes.
+ Conduct thorough assessments of current systems and identify opportunities for improvement and optimization.
+ Ensure the architecture adheres to best practices, standards, and compliance requirements.
+ Develop reference architectures and blueprints


* Project Leadership
+ Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including business stakeholders, developers, and IT professionals, to ensure successful project delivery.
+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to project team members.
+ Monitor project progress, identify potential risks, and develop mitigation strategies.


* Technical Expertise
+ Strong experience of SAP solutions, including SAP HANA, SAP Fiori, SAP BW, SAP ECC, SAP PI/PO, SAP BTP, SAP SLT (not exhaustive)
+ Stay up\-to\-date with the latest SAP technologies, trends, and best practices.
+ Conduct technical reviews and evaluations of proposed solutions to ensure feasibility and effectiveness.
+ Collaborate with vendors and partners to evaluate and select appropriate SAP tools and services.


* Integration and Optimization
+ Design and implement integration strategies to ensure seamless data flow between SAP systems and other EY enterprise applications.
+ Identify and resolve technical issues and bottlenecks to enhance system efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in SAP solution architecture and implementation.
* Proven experience in designing and implementing SAP solutions for large\-scale enterprises.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong leadership and project management abilities.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Flexibility to work across time zones and collaborate with global teams.
* Relevant SAP certifications are a plus, but not required.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

77fdd112.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job description \-** 
**Manager – Cloud (Risk Consulting – Digital Risk)**
**Requisition ID \- TBC**
 EY focuses on high\-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities. At EY GDS, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY GDS become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The objective of our Risk Consulting services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions enable clients to build confidence and trust with customers, regulators, and the broader market.
   

  

 Within Cloud Risk and Security, this role focuses on leading engagements that assess, test, and validate cloud security and risk controls across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments. The role involves working closely with IT, cloud engineering, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that cloud environments are secure, resilient, and aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Operate as a fieldwork leader, assisting clients in identifying, assessing, and monitoring cloud\-related security and technology risks.
* Lead and execute cloud security and risk assessments, including control design and operating effectiveness testing across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Collaborate with engagement teams to plan engagements, develop work programs, timelines, risk assessments, and testing procedures.
* Serve as a fieldwork leader by directing daily testing activities, tracking engagement progress, and managing staff performance.
* Perform cloud architecture and configuration reviews covering landing zones, identity models, network segmentation, encryption and key management, logging and monitoring, and backup and disaster recovery.
* Assess cloud governance and security controls aligned to shared responsibility models and industry frameworks.
* Prepare high\-quality deliverables, reports, and recommendations aligned with US work product quality standards.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong fundamentals across cloud risk and cloud security, with hands\-on experience across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong audit mindset with the ability to design, execute, and evidence control testing across cloud environments.
* Proven experience leading cloud security audits, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and maturity assessments.
* Practical experience assessing controls related to identity and access management, network security, encryption and KMS, logging and monitoring/SIEM, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection.
* Experience with containerized and cloud\-native environments, including Kubernetes, serverless, and workload security.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-location teams, manage delivery risks, and deliver high\-quality outcomes within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (non\-negotiable).
* Ability to manage time effectively and work in US time zones, as per project needs.
* Exposure to cyber\-related risk or security activities is an added advantage.


**Behavioral Skills**
* Demonstrates adaptability and agility, with a strong commitment to continuous learning across cloud platforms and emerging technologies.
* Exhibits end\-to\-end engagement leadership, delivering cloud security audits and risk assessments across complex environments.
* Brings an innovation\-oriented mindset, leveraging automation and analytics to enhance control testing efficiency and continuous monitoring.
* Actively contributes to practice\-building initiatives, including development of accelerators, tools, and reusable assets.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide teams to deliver high\-quality outcomes.
* Communicates effectively and manages stakeholder expectations across technical and business audiences.


**To qualify for the role, you must have.**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 7–12 years of total experience, including 3–5 years in cloud security or cloud risk roles.
* Cloud security certifications such as CCSP or CCSK, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience in cloud security audits, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and control testing.
* Experience designing and assessing controls across identity and access management, network security, encryption and KMS, logging and monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and compliance standards such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and privacy expectations.
* Client\-facing experience working with engineering, security, and risk stakeholders.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Exposure to container security, Kubernetes, Zero Trust concepts, SASE/SSE, CASB, or cloud\-native security tooling is preferred.
* Experience supporting regulated industries or large\-scale cloud transformations or migrations is an added advantage.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
