e84e68d4.title: Solutions Architect- IP
e84e68d4.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
   

  

 TTEC Digital seeks a Solutions Architect to join our team. This role is a full\-time and fully remote opportunity!
   

  

**The work:**
 We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early\-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982\.
   

  

 This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
   

  

**Who we hire — the DNA:**
* Self\-starters and do\-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show\-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI\-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed\-systems literate. High\-efficiency, event\-driven, low\-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well\-rounded, smart people who move fast


**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**
* The technical face to enterprise customers — scoping deployments, designing tenant configurations, and getting customers live fast (same\-day with Desktop Intercept).
* You're selling and deploying a platform that combines voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI — technology that changes monthly — so you learn constantly and demo fearlessly
* Startup environment: the deal, the deployment, and the product are all moving at once, and you thrive in that.


**What you'll own:**
* Pre\-sales and deployment architecture
* Tenant configuration and plugin enablement design
* Customer integration scoping (CCaaS / CRM / SIP)
* live demos that win — show\-me applies to customers too
* The customer's voice back into Product and Engineering
* Your committed go\-live timelines.


**Who you are:**
* A self\-starter with grit and a closer's instinct — you like winning, and a signed customer going live is your scoreboard
* Show\-me mentality: you'd rather run the live demo than present the slide
* You adapt fast when the product shifts under you (it will, weekly), love new technology, and use AI tools daily — including in your own demo and scoping workflow
* A do\-er who owns the messy middle instead of escalating it
* A team player who translates in both directions: business requirements into technical needs for engineering, platform capability into business value for the customer.


**What You Will Bring:**
* 8\+ years of solutions architecture/sales engineering in contact\-center, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS.
* Technical enough to design an integration on a whiteboard and credible enough to own a CTO conversation — you keep the respect of senior engineers on both sides of the table.
* Knows CCaaS / CTI, SIP / RTP, and CRM landscapes cold.
* Strong working knowledge of the modern AI stack — LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, transcription/translation — deep enough to answer the customer's AI architecture and data\-security questions without phoning home.
* Has taken enterprise customers live and owned the messy middle — network quirks, security reviews, procurement, the works.
* Hands\-on enough to configure a tenant, read an API payload, and debug a customer integration in real time — a troubleshooter, not a talker: when the pilot breaks at 4pm, you isolate it.
* Understands event\-driven platform architecture well enough to scope custom integrations accurately — what's config, what's a connector, what's a feature request.
* Deployment playbook craft — turns every go\-live into a repeatable playbook so the second customer is faster than the first; this is how one SA scales.
* Enterprise security fluency — comfortable in InfoSec reviews (SOC 2, data residency, PII/redaction, AI data\-usage questions); AI deals die here without it.
* Competitive positioning depth — knows the CCaaS/agent\-assist landscape and can architect around a competitor's incumbency.
* POC discipline — scopes pilots with clear success criteria and exit dates, so pilots convert instead of drifting.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

0463084b.title: Senior Partner Solution Engineer
0463084b.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that’s all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.


We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.


Snowflake partners, from System Integrators (SI), Cloud Service Providers (CSP) and Technology Partners (ISV) are an integral part of Snowflake business to help customers unlock Power of Snowflake AI Data Cloud.


We are seeking a highly motivated and proactive individual to drive the technical growth in this Partner ecosystem.


This role demands a technical expert capable of driving success by aligning with key programs and significantly enhancing partner knowledge of crucial product features. The candidate must effectively present to both technical and executive audiences, utilising methods from whiteboarding to presentations and demonstrations, to cultivating strong mind share among Snowflake Partners across India.


We require a candidate with a demonstrable history of successful engagement with major partners and a proven ability to develop technical champions within their organisations. Ideal candidates will possess a deep understanding of the broader Platform ecosystem, including products and the competitive landscape, enabling them to influence and serve as the partners' trusted technical advisor.


This role requires travel up to 50% within India throughout the quarter to support partner engagement such as enablement, deal support and marketing events.

**AS A PARTNER SOLUTION ENGINEER, YOU WILL:**

* Collaborate closely with Snowflake's Partner, Sales, and Solutions Engineering teams to promote and implement optimal solutions with our partners.
* Design and deliver technical training, workshops, and certifications to upskill partner teams on Snowflake architecture and best practices based on joint business goals.
* Co\-develop industry\-specific solutions and accelerators with partners (e.g., data migration frameworks, industry data models, Power of N motions). Aligning Snowflake's products to maximise impact on their service offerings.
* Present at Snowflake and Partner events, lead hackathons, and drive Snowflake awareness and adoption within partner organisations.
* Partner closely on strategic customer engagements, collaborating with partners to define use cases, deliver compelling presentations, execute successful Proofs of Concept (POCs), and ensure positive outcomes.
* Own the technology roadmap with the partners, to build and scale their Snowflake practices with reference architectures and delivery methodologies.
* Advocate for partner and customer needs with Snowflake product teams.

**OUR IDEAL PARTNER SOLUTION ENGINEER WILL HAVE:**

* Have 10\+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Experience working with Global Systems Integrators, Regional System Integrators, Cloud Service Providers and Technology Partners within the region.
* Developed data domain thought leadership within a partner community.
* Deep comprehension of Partner revenue models, industry priorities and challenges they navigate.
* Proven experience in designing and building highly scalable data pipelines using Spark, Kafka to ingest data from various systems.
* Strong SQL and data warehousing fundamentals (cloud DW experience preferred)
* Experience with Snowflake Technology Partners that specialise in Data Engineering, Data Science, Collaboration and Cyber Security.
* Hands\-on technical experience with DevOps and CI/CD processes and tools, such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, and Google Cloud Build.
* Strong experience with major cloud platforms and tooling, especially Azure, AWS and Google Cloud.
* Experience using Big Data or Cloud integration technologies such as Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, etc.
* Experience with AI/ML use cases is a plus.


Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.


How do you want to make your impact?


For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

6d3949bd.title: Senior AI & Automation Solutions Engineer (m/f/d)
6d3949bd.description:
**City:** Gurugram  

**Department:** Human Resources


**Recruiter:** Tavleen Bindra

  

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.



Joining the People \& Organization Digital Transformation team, you will work directly with the Head of Digital Transformation and a close\-knit team of four engineers based in Berlin. Your work will span automation engineering, AI application deployment on top of HR systems — with direct impact on how Flix manages its people technology globally. This is a pure technical role. There is no administrative overhead, no time\-critical firefighting and no expectation of HR domain expertise on day one — we can teach you the domain. This is an exciting, problem\-solving\-focused role at the intersection of AI, automation, and HR solution architecture. While the technical skills can be developed, what we cannot teach is the engineering mindset, depth of integration expertise, and natural instinct for automation that this role demands.



This is a hybrid role based in Gurugram with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. The role has a Europe and APAC\-facing scope, with regular collaboration across Central European time zones.


**About the Role**


* Lead the technical workstream supporting internal automation projects —evaluating global HR system options, assessing integration complexity, mapping data dependencies and supporting potential migration execution from Workday or equivalent enterprise HR platforms.
* Design and build automation and integration workflows using n8n,UiPath and Python — including multi\-step orchestration, exception handling, retries, monitoring, alerting and structured documentation.
* Build and maintain enterprise system integrations using REST APIs,OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, SFTP and event\-driven patterns across the HR technology landscape.
* Develop secure AI integrations connecting platforms such as Claude with HRIS and enterprise systems using MCP servers, connectors, plugins and agent frameworks — with appropriate access controls and user\-level permissions.
* Deploy and operate internal applications and AI\-powered tools on Flix's hosting infrastructure (AWS), including RBAC/ABAC access models, secrets management, credential rotation and audit logging.
* Analyse business processes end\-to\-end, identify automation opportunities and design scalable target\-state architectures that can support both the evaluation phase and eventual migration or implementation execution.
* Engage with cross\-functional stakeholders across Europe and APAC —translating complex technical requirements into clear solution designs and project deliverables across 3–6 month project scopes.


**About You**


* 6–7\+ years of hands\-on professional experience in automation engineering, systems integration, solution architecture or AI application development. Exceptional mid\-level candidates with strong technical depth will also be considered.
* Demonstrable experience building and delivering automation workflows and enterprise integrations — this is an engineering role, not a data analytics or reporting role. Experience in Python, n8n and UiPath is essential.
* Strong working knowledge of API design and integration patterns —REST APIs, OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, SFTP and event\-driven architectures.
* Hands\-on experience deploying and operating applications on AWS,including Lambda, API Gateway, Bedrock, Glue, Secrets Manager and CI/CD pipeline management.
* Solid software engineering fundamentals — Git/GitHub, Docker,structured release management and familiarity with security practices including least privilege, RBAC/ABAC and credential handling.
* Experience with Workday or enterprise HRIS platforms (configuration, integration or migration) is a strong advantage and a meaningful differentiator — though not an absolute requirement if your automation and integration fundamentals are strong.
* Comfort working across European and APAC time zones, collaborating with a Berlin\-based team and contributing to strategic cross\-functional initiatives.
* n8n Level 1 or Level 2 certification is strongly preferred.


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!


**What We Offer**


* **Travel perks**: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* **Work from (M)Anywhere**: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* **Hybrid work model**: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* **Wellbeing support**: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* **Learning \& Development**: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* **Mentoring Program**: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


To view more local benefits specific to each office location,



**Why Join Flix?**



At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.  

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.



If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

981a6c9a.title: AI/ML Architect
981a6c9a.description:
**Job Title:** AI/ML Architect  
**Experience:** 10\+ Years  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time / Contract  
**Location:** Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced **AI/ML Architect** to design and implement enterprise\-grade Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in **Generative AI, AI Agents, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AI Governance, Python**, and modern full\-stack technologies. This role requires strong architecture, solution design, and cloud implementation experience to build scalable AI\-powered applications.

Mandatory Skills

* **AI/ML Architecture**
* Generative AI (Gen AI)
* AI Agents
* **Azure AI Foundry**
* **Azure OpenAI**
* **Azure AI Governance**
* **Azure Functions**
* **Azure Storage**
* **Azure DevOps**
* **Python**
* React.js
* Node.js
* Power BI

Key Responsibilities

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. **Job Description:**

  



HPE Financial Services (HPEFS) within HPE is looking for a dynamic and technically grounded **Manager** to join our growing team in Bengaluru. This role sits at the intersection of **Automation, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence**, driving the digital agenda by maintaining, and evolving intelligent solutions that create measurable business value. This role is designed to scale to a people manager role while staying deeply connected to the technical craft — architecting solutions, enforcing governance, and championing a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.


If you are passionate about building scalable digital ecosystems, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and bring both leadership acumen and technical depth, this role is designed for you.

**HPE Financial services** is where we help organizations create the investment they need for digital transformation, in an innovative and sustainable way. We partner with customers across their entire IT asset portfolio from edge to cloud to end\-user. Unique to each client’s aspirations and size, our financial and asset management solutions are anchored by best\-in\-class tech upcycling services.

**What You'll Do**

**Digital Solutions Delivery \& Maintenance**

* Own the maintenance, enhancement \& continuous improvement of digital solutions spanning automation, analytics, and AI
* Ensure stability, performance, and scalability of existing digital assets while proactively identifying opportunities for optimization and modernization
* Serve as a technical escalation point for the team, driving resolution of complex issues across the digital portfolio

**Automation**

* Identify and prioritize automation enhancements \& sustainment across business functions, delivering measurable efficiency gains
* Establish, maintain and enforce automation best practices, coding standards, and reusable component libraries
* Develop self healing automation framework to reduce L1, L2 support needs year over year

**Analytics**

* Oversee the sustainment and governance of data visualization and reporting solutions using Power BI, Qlik Sense, or similar platforms
* Partner with business stakeholders to translate data requirements into actionable insights and dashboards that support decision\-making
* Drive adoption of self\-service analytics capabilities across the organization

**Artificial Intelligence**

* Lead the deployment, sustainment and adoption of AI agents and copilot solutions leveraging Microsoft Copilot Studio and adjacent AI platforms
* Stay current with the evolving AI landscape — including LLMs, generative AI models, and emerging AI tools — and evaluate their applicability to business use cases
* Champion responsible AI practices in alignment with HPE's governance and compliance standards

**Governance \& Accelerators**

* Proactively identify new tools and platforms to help solve business problems and improve internal ways of working
* Continuously evolve the delivery governance framework to ensure solutions are built with consistency, quality, security, and compliance at the core
* Own the implementation and maintenance of delivery accelerators — reusable templates, frameworks, and components — to fast\-track solution delivery and maximize reusability across the portfolio
* Ensure all digital solutions are delivered in alignment with HPE's governance policies, data privacy standards, and architectural principles
* Define and track KPIs and metrics to measure the effectiveness and adoption of digital solutions
* Maintain constant integration touch points \& working sessions with HPEFS IT, HPE IT and HPE data office to comply with governance and standards.

**Team Leadership \& Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 5–8 digital solutions professionals, fostering a high\-performance and growth\-oriented culture
* Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and support career development for peers and Jr. individual contributors in alignment with HPE's performance management framework
* Build team capability across automation, analytics, and AI disciplines through structured learning and hands\-on project exposure
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with business stakeholders, IT, and global digital teams to align priorities and drive outcomes

**What You'll Bring**

**Experience \& Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of progressive experience in digital solutions, with a strong emphasis on automation, analytics, and AI
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience building and maintaining digital footprints at scale within a complex enterprise environment
* 3\+ years of people management experience, with a proven track record of leading teams of 5–8 members
* Experience working within or building delivery governance frameworks in a structured enterprise setting
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

**Technical Skills**

* **Automation:** Hands\-on experience with UiPath (preferred), WorkFusion, or equivalent RPA/IPA tools.
* **Analytics:** Proficient in SQL (complex queries, stored procedures). Experience with Power BI (DAX, data modelling) and Qlik Sense (scripting, set analysis).
* **Artificial Intelligence:** Demonstrated experience building AI agents on Microsoft Copilot Studio. Working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, and tools such as Azure OpenAI, ChatGPT, or equivalent platforms.
* **Digital Footprint:** Track record of building and maintaining a broad digital solution estate — spanning multiple tools and platforms — over 8–10 years.
* **Leadership:** Minimum 2–3 years of experience managing teams of 5 or more. Strong coaching and performance management skills.
* **Governance:** Familiarity with delivery governance frameworks, SDLC best practices, and change management processes.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Python or low\-code/no\-code platforms (e.g. Power Automate, Alteryx)
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, especially AI/ML services.
* Knowledge of MLOps practices or experience deploying machine learning models in production.
* Certifications in UiPath, Microsoft Power Platform, or relevant AI/data disciplines.
* Experience working in a shared services, BPO, or global delivery centre environment.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health \& Wellbeing**


We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal \& Professional Development**


We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**


We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

**Let's Stay Connected:**


Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

47e2b6bc.description:
**About UptimeAI**
 UptimeAI provides AI reasoning agents that help industrial operations teams make goal\-oriented, real\-time decisions.
   

  

 Industrial facilities are rich in data but constrained by the expertise required to maintain and interpret it. As experienced engineers retire and operational complexity grows, organizations struggle to scale the expert judgment needed to maintain reliability, safety, and performance.
   

  

 UptimeAI addresses this challenge by embedding engineering reasoning directly into AI agents that continuously analyze operational data, diagnose issues, and guide teams toward the best actions. The result is faster decisions, reduced downtime, improved efficiency, and stronger operational performance.
   

  

**Role : Solutions Engineer**
**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8\+ years
   

  

**Department:** 
 Sales \& BDM
   

  

**Role Overview**
 UptimeAI is a venture\-backed startup reinventing manufacturing operations with enterprise AI software for heavy industries like refining, chemicals, and renewables. UptimeAI offers an AI\-based virtual assistant for machine and process operators to help them solve reliability and performance problems faster, like the experts. UptimeAI uniquely combines the latest AI techniques, 200\+ years of operational knowledge, and self\-learning workflows to maximize operational margins, working with large enterprises like Tata Power and BPCL.
   

  

 We are looking to hire a dynamic, customer\-oriented Solution Engineer. You will work with the sales team and prospects to build the technical and business case around improving operational excellence in heavy asset industries, with a specific focus on process industries such as refining and chemicals. As a bridge between sales and engineering, you will own aligning the customer's pain point to UptimeAI's offering and convincing client management on the technical and ROI aspects.
   

  

 This individual must be a highly motivated, outgoing self\-starter who enjoys problem\-solving, cutting\-edge technology, and sales equally, and is not afraid to explore new industries and new pain points.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Oversee and participate in initial discovery meetings with customers, providing platform demos and highly technical proof\-of\-value engagements for both existing customers and new sales opportunities using UptimeAI's predictive maintenance software
* Act as a subject matter expert of the assigned product portfolio in predictive analytics, operations and maintenance, chemical engineering, and asset performance management, targeting process industries including power, oil and gas, and chemicals
* Be the direct conduit translating customer business challenges into technical solutions, positioning UptimeAI to effectively solve those challenges
* Consistently and cogently address customers' needs through strong verbal, written, and presentation skills
* Provide analysis and solution design activities, such as requirements gathering and gap analysis of user requirements
* Support the project team in solution design, architecture review, and functional and technical requirements discovery, definition, and documentation
* Implement complete solutions by blending deep understanding of process domains (P\&ID, PFD, equipment, process knowledge) with technical knowledge of UptimeAI's software features and capabilities for customers in power, oil and gas, chemical, and other process industries
* Build, manage, and maintain strong relationships with customers, peers, and partners
* Travel expected to be 40\-60% to engage with customers and prospects in person
* Participate in marketing campaigns and events


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience
* Bachelor's degree or higher in chemical engineering or an equivalent discipline is required
* Prior experience with predictive analytics tools and offerings, including artificial intelligence applications or digital solutions like APM and simulation
* Ability to build a business case and convince upper management on value
* Prior operations and maintenance experience working in a process industry such as oil and gas or chemicals is required
* Strong operational knowledge in operations and maintenance on the process side, such as reactors and process understanding, is required
* General experience related to industrial automation and manufacturing, including industrial data sources, systems, and communication methods such as SCADA, OPC, historians, DCS, etc.
* Experience with CMMS systems, Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), or work in a maintenance capacity in a manufacturing or industrial environment is required
* Desire to work in a people\-facing role that spans both technical and sales activities


**Why join UptimeAI**
* Impact industry\-wide change: contribute to transformative solutions that significantly improve operational efficiency and reliability for global clients
* Collaborative and growth\-oriented environment: join a talented, passionate team that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth
* Opportunities for leadership and innovation: lead pioneering projects, influence product development, and shape the future of industrial AI solutions

0844e9c5.title: IN-Sr Technical Consultant - Cloud - AKS, Azure update manager, Azure automation, Patching, AZ-104 / AZ-400
0844e9c5.description:
**Scope**
 The Azure Infra Engineer \- Patching \& Maintenance keeps our Azure platform secure, current, and compliant by owning the end\-to\-end patch and maintenance lifecycle. This mid\-level role runs the weekly patch cycle across compute, containers, and platform services, and proactively tracks every core component against vendor End\-of\-Life / End\-of\-Support timelines, upgrading to supported versions before support lapses. It is a hands\-on operations role with a strong automation focus and close coordination with service owners, security, and DevOps.
   

  

**Our Current Technical Environment**
* Software: Azure Update Manager, Azure Automation, Azure Policy (Guest Configuration), PowerShell, Bash, and Azure CLI; ServiceNow for change management / CAB.
* Application Architecture: Microservices on AKS (Stratosphere), Portal Shell and Portal Collaboration runtimes, the Event Framework (Event Grid / Service Bus), IAM, and API Management (self\-hosted gateway).
* Cloud Architecture: Microsoft Azure \- Windows / Linux VMs, AKS node pools, MongoDB (Atlas), Entra ID / IAM, and APIM, with patch compliance and maintenance across every layer.
* Frameworks/Others: Kubernetes / Helm, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, vulnerability \& CVE remediation workflows, and EOL/EOS lifecycle tracking; WSUS / SCCM, Ansible / Terraform, and ITIL practices; AZ\-104 / AZ\-400 aligned.


**What You’ll Do**
* Plan and execute the weekly patch cycle for Windows/Linux VMs, AKS node pools, and platform middleware using Azure Update Manager and Azure Automation.
* Publish and maintain a rolling maintenance calendar, coordinating patch windows with service owners to minimise business disruption.
* Track OS, runtime, and dependency versions across IAM, APIM, MongoDB, Stratosphere, Portal Shell/Collaboration, and the Event Framework against vendor EOL/EOS timelines, and plan upgrade paths to supported or LTS versions well ahead of EOL.
* Test patches and upgrades in non\-production and validate rollback procedures before every production rollout.
* Automate patch deployment and compliance reporting using Azure Update Manager, Azure Policy guest configuration, and Automation runbooks; monitor compliance dashboards and remediate non\-compliant resources within SLA.
* Coordinate emergency, out\-of\-band patching for critical CVEs and zero\-day vulnerabilities with the security team.
* Manage AKS cluster and node image upgrades, Helm chart bumps, and container base image refresh cycles; renew TLS certificates, keys, and secrets nearing expiry with the IAM team.
* Maintain patch and maintenance documentation (change records, rollback plans, validation checklists) and report weekly patch compliance and EOL risk status to engineering leadership.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 5\-8 years in infrastructure operations, patch management, or SRE roles, with proven ability to plan and execute maintenance windows at minimal service disruption.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure Update Manager, Azure Automation, and Azure Policy guest configuration; patching Windows Server and Linux VM fleets at scale.
* Familiarity with AKS node image upgrades and Kubernetes version lifecycle management, plus EOL/EOS lifecycle tracking for OS, databases, and middleware.
* Experience with change management (ServiceNow CAB, scheduled maintenance windows) and vulnerability / CVE remediation workflows.
* Scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or Azure CLI for patch automation; AZ\-104 or AZ\-400 certification preferred.
* Nice to have: WSUS / SCCM, MongoDB Atlas automated upgrades, Ansible / Terraform, ITIL Foundation, and experience building EOL/EOS dashboards or CMDB integrations.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

2df7226b.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
2df7226b.description:
****This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in\-office.****
 Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning, and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, ideas\-led environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
 The Priceline Cloud Development Team is responsible for running the company’s current cloud infrastructure. It works closely with members from product, engineering, support, and infrastructure teams to satisfy system needs in line with the group’s technical vision and strategies.
   

  

**In This Role You Will Get To**
* Lead engagement with engineering and infrastructure to deliver robust, high\-traffic cloud services from inception to full operation.
* Support an agile team to integrate/implement the infrastructure for a 12\-factor, containerized/microservice platform.
* Lead in the development of cloud\-focused tooling to allow technology teams to apply cloud services.

* Organize tasks and resources to complete work and meet deadlines.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or equivalent experience).
* Five or more years of dynamically more complex related experience.
* In\-depth knowledge and experience with running distributed systems in public cloud environments such as GCP, AWS, and Azure.
* In\-depth knowledge of container orchestration platforms and technologies such as Kubernetes and Istio.
* In\-depth knowledge of declarative infrastructure\-as\-code systems such as Terraform.
* Knowledge of configuration management systems such as Chef, Puppet, and Ansible.
* Experience in programming languages such as Python, Go, Bash.
* Comfortable with Linux command line. Familiar with Linux system administration, networking, and load balancing concepts
* Experience in CICD automation using tools \- GitHub and GitHub Actions.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability, and Trust.
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics are essential.


**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
 Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding \- we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
   

  

 Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown\-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
   

  

 We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
   

  

 Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
   

  

 If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
   

  

**Flexible work at Priceline**
 Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
   

  

**Perks \& Benefits At Priceline**
 Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
   

  

**Health \& wellness coverage** 
 including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
   

  

**Generous time off** 
 including PTO, holidays, a company\-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
   

  

**Work/life support** 
 including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
   

  

**Financial security programs** 
 such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax\-advantaged accounts
   

  

**Signature travel perks** 
 including employee\-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
   

  

**Additional perks \& discounts** 
 like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
   

  

**A people\-first culture** 
 with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
   

  

*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
 To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
   

  

 Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
   

  

**Applying for this position**
 We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all

 External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

355bb42e.title: PMO Program Manager (Automotive - Connectivity)
355bb42e.description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a strategic and execution\-focused Senior Portfolio PMO Program Manager to strengthen portfolio governance, operating discipline, and business transparency across HARMAN SBU Connectivity Portfolio Team. Based in India, this role will partner with global product, engineering, finance, sales, and business leaders to translate portfolio priorities into measurable plans, clear decisions, and predictable outcomes.
   

  

 The successful candidate will operate beyond traditional status reporting. The role will establish governance routines, integrate portfolio data, identify risks and dependencies early, and enable leadership decisions through fact\-based insights. This position may support one or multiple product lines (per business need) and strategic initiatives while promoting common processes, accountability, and continuous improvement across the portfolio.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Lead portfolio governance and execution\-enablement activities across assigned Connectivity product lines and strategic initiatives.
* Plan and facilitate portfolio operating cadences, including monthly status reviews, QBRs, portfolio reviews, decision forums, and leadership workshops.
* Prepare decision\-oriented materials that clearly summarize portfolio health, key milestones, risks, dependencies, financial status, and actions requiring leadership attention.
* Establish and maintain integrated portfolio plans, milestones, roadmaps, and cross\-functional dependencies; ensure alignment with approved business priorities.
* Drive consistent application of HARMAN business management, product lifecycle, and governance processes, including compliance with applicable BMS and PLM requirements.
* Coordinate the definition and tracking of portfolio OKRs, KPIs, and execution metrics; identify trends, gaps, and corrective actions.
* Partner with Finance and product leaders to support business\-case governance, budget planning, forecast\-versus\-actual reviews, investment tracking, and financial risk visibility.
* Support demand, capacity, and resource planning by consolidating needs, highlighting constraints, and facilitating trade\-off decisions across functions and programs.
* Own portfolio\-level risk, issue, action, and decision tracking; ensure timely escalation with clear impact analysis and recommended options.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment among Product Management, Engineering, Finance, Quality, Sales, Business Development, and regional teams.
* Improve portfolio transparency through standardized dashboards, reporting templates, data quality controls, and traceability across planning and execution tools.
* Facilitate resolution of execution barriers by clarifying ownership, due dates, dependencies, and decision paths.
* Conduct governance and process reviews, identify recurring gaps, and implement practical continuous\-improvement actions.
* Support portfolio communication and change\-management activities, ensuring stakeholders understand priorities, governance expectations, and operating\-model changes.
* Mentor project and program management colleagues and promote a collaborative, accountable, and data\-driven PMO culture.


 What You Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, Finance, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
* Typically 12\+ years of overall professional experience, including at least 8 years in program management, portfolio management, PMO, product operations, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience leading governance and execution across complex, global, cross\-functional product or technology portfolios.
* Strong working knowledge of portfolio planning, milestone management, dependency management, risk and issue management, and executive reporting.
* Experience with financial governance, including budgets, forecasts, business cases, investment tracking, and variance analysis.
* Ability to synthesize complex information into concise, decision\-ready insights for senior leaders.
* Excellent facilitation, stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively across cultures, functions, and time zones.
* Proficiency with common portfolio and reporting tools such as Microsoft 365, Jira, Confluence, Aha!, Salesforce, Power BI, Qlik, or equivalent platforms.
* Automotive, connected\-product, embedded software, electronics, or mobility industry experience is preferred.


 What Is Nice to Have
   

  

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline.
* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Agile, Lean, or portfolio\-management certification.
* Experience with automotive telematics, connectivity, software platforms, or product lifecycle management.
* Experience implementing or transforming a PMO operating model, governance framework, or portfolio reporting capability.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams across India, Europe, Asia, and North America.


 What Makes You Eligible
   

  

* Be willing to work from a HARMAN office in India in accordance with the applicable hybrid or on\-site work policy.
* Be willing to travel up to 20% domestically and internationally, including travel to HARMAN and customer locations when required.
* Successfully complete any required employment, background, and compliance checks.


 What We Offer
   

  

 HARMAN FlexConnect Program, offering a flexible hybrid work environment that fosters stronger collaboration, meaningful connections, and innovation through a minimum of three in\-office days per week.
   

  

* Access to employee discounts on world\-class HARMAN/Samsung products (JBL, Harman Kardon, AKG, etc.)
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages career development opportunities
* Flexible work schedule with a culture encouraging work\-life integration and collaboration in a global environment
* On\-site opportunities to focus on personal well\-being and development such as onsite café, fitness center, weekly massage, fitness classes, and other onsite events promoted by our Employee resource groups
* Professional development opportunities through HARMAN University’s business and leadership academies
* Internal talent management leadership acceleration programs
* “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program
* Scholarship programs for employee family members


**You Belong Here**
 HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support\-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
   

  

**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next\-Level Technology**
 Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
   

  

 Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award\-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
   

  

 If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!
   

  

**Important Notice: Recruitment Scams**
 Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.
   

  

 HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job\-related performance.(www.harman.com)

 .

* Collaborate directly with the founders and influence product strategy.
* Own customer conversations from discovery to solution design.

 We're not looking for traditional pre\-sales professionals.
 



 We're looking for curious problem solvers who enjoy understanding customer challenges, designing innovative AI solutions, and helping shape products that solve real\-world problems.
 



  





 If you're excited about working with cutting\-edge AI technology, love interacting with enterprise customers, and want to build something meaningful from the ground up,

f692dfaf.description:

Full time

IT Services

### **Job Description**


**Job Title: Technical Architect**

  

Role Summary

  

We are seeking a highly capable Technical Architect – Azure Integration with strong experience in architecting cloud\-based integration solutions.

  

This role is focused on technical design, architectural ownership, and building scalable systems across multiple products. The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on expertise, a strong foundation in modern architecture patterns, and the ability to guide engineering teams through complex technical challenges.

 **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own and drive architecture and design decisions for multiple products and integration platforms.
* Define scalable, resilient, and secure system architectures using modern cloud\-native approaches.
* Design and implement microservices\-based and event\-driven architectures.
* Architect and develop APIs using C\#, .NET/.NET Core, and GraphQL.
* Lead technical design discussions, produce architecture documents, and ensure alignment with business goals.
* Provide technical guidance and oversight to engineering teams without direct people management responsibilities.
* Ensure adherence to best practices in scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Design cloud\-native integration solutions on Microsoft Azure.
* Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Drive end\-to\-end solution design, including integration patterns, data flow, and system interactions.
* Identify and resolve complex architectural and system\-level challenges.
* Contribute to continuous improvement in architecture standards, DevOps practices, and engineering processes.

 **Required Skills \& Expertise**

  

Architecture \& Design

  

* Strong experience in solution and application architecture across multiple systems/products.
* Deep understanding of design patterns, clean architecture, and scalable system design.
* Expertise in microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Experience with event\-driven and integration patterns.

  

Technical Skills

  

* Strong proficiency in C\# and .NET / .NET Core.
* Solid experience building RESTful APIs and GraphQL services.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including:
+ App Services
+ Azure Functions
+ Azure API Management
+ Service Bus
+ Storage services

* Experience designing cloud\-native and distributed applications.
* Strong knowledge of authentication and authorization (OAuth, JWT, Azure AD).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted development within the SDLC.
* Experience with SQL Server and/or NoSQL databases.
* Knowledge of API design standards, versioning, and documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI).
* Strong focus on performance optimization and scalability.

dd17e30c.title: Solution Architect - MERN
dd17e30c.description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking an experienced **Solution Architect \- MERN** to lead the development of scalable, high\-performing full\-stack web applications, drive technical excellence across the team, and ensure the delivery of secure, accessible, and high\-quality software solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the development of scalable, high\-performing full\-stack web applications using Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, ReactJS, and AWS Cloud
* Design and implement advanced components in ReactJS using TypeScript, manage state with Redux or Redux Toolkit, and ensure code efficiency and reusability
* Oversee the integration of Apollo GraphQL Client to manage data and state in a networked React app
* Ensure internationalization and web accessibility (AA standard) compliance across all web applications
* Deploy and manage applications on AWS, utilizing its various services to optimize architecture and performance
* Maintain brand consistency using theming libraries and ensure high\-quality user interfaces with HTML/CSS and SCSS
* Enhance application security and user authentication, safeguarding user data and compliance with modern web security protocols
* Develop, implement, and oversee unit testing strategies using React Testing Library to ensure robust and error\-free code
* Collaborate in an agile environment, manage tasks and timelines effectively using agile methodologies
* Mentor and guide developers, promoting a culture of learning and growth within the team

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* 10\+ years of full\-stack development experience
* Proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, and AWS Cloud services
* Expertise in ReactJS framework including JSX/TSX, Redux/Redux Toolkit, Middleware, and Routing
* Knowledge of Lifecycle methods, Hooks, HOC, Memoization, and Optimization
* Proficiency with NextJS, Apollo GraphQL Client, and familiarity with web theming and SCSS
* Understanding of web accessibility (AA standards) and internationalization
* Background in web security practices and user authentication strategies
* Competency in unit testing using RTL and familiarity with agile project management practices

**Nice to have**

* Ecommerce domain experience

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

3cd7ad0a.description:
**Job Description**
 This is a remote position.
   

  

**We are seeking a Technical Architect with 10\+ years of overall technology experience, including proven experience architecting and delivering production Generative AI systems. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands\-on command of large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, and Agentic architectures with the judgement to design AI solutions that hold up under real enterprise constraints of cost, latency, security, and compliance. This role owns the technical architecture of AI engagements end\-to\-end: shaping the solution during discovery and pre\-sales, defining reference architectures and integration patterns, selecting models and platforms, and guiding delivery teams through implementation. You will work directly with client stakeholders, product managers and engineering leads, and will help set the technical standards of our AI practice. This is a senior, hands\-on architecture role rather than a purely advisory one. This role owns multiple concurrent AI engagements from discovery through production. Beyond technical architecture, the Technical Architect is expected to act as a trusted advisor to clients, lead engineering teams, mentor future technical leaders, and drive engineering excellence through hands\-on involvement.**
**Requirements**
 Responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end architecture of GenAI solutions across the retrieval, orchestration, model, integration, and deployment layers.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into AI solution designs with clear scope, feasibility assessment and success metrics.
* Define reference architectures, design patterns and reusable accelerators for RAG, agentic workflows and LLM integration.
* Lead model and platform selection, documenting the cost, latency, accuracy and data\-residency trade\-offs behind each decision.
* Design the non\-functional envelope: scalability, latency budgets, availability, observability and inference cost control.
* Architect data and retrieval pipelines covering ingestion, chunking, embedding strategy, vector store selection and hybrid search.
* Define evaluation strategy and guardrails so accuracy, groundedness, safety and hallucination rates can be measured and governed.
* Embed security, privacy and compliance into the design: PII handling, tenancy isolation, access control and audit.
* Support pre\-sales and discovery through solution workshops, effort estimation, technical proposals and client presentations.
* Guide delivery teams, run design reviews and mentor engineers, while staying hands\-on in prototyping and unblocking hard problems.
* Maintain architecture documentation and decision records, and assess which advances in generative AI are ready for enterprise adoption.
* Own multiple client engagements simultaneously while maintaining delivery quality.
* Lead discovery workshops, challenge assumptions, and refine business requirements into technically sound solutions.
* Push back on unrealistic timelines, architectures, or requirements using engineering judgement and data.
* Build strong relationships with Team, product owners, and executive stakeholders.
* Mentor senior engineers and cultivate future architects and technical leaders.
* Lead architectural governance, design reviews, and technical decision records.
* Set engineering standards, coding guidelines, AI development best practices, and review critical code.
* Remain hands\-on by building prototypes, solving difficult technical problems, and contributing production\-quality code when needed.
* Drive cross\-project reuse through internal frameworks, accelerators, and reference implementations.
* Present architecture, trade\-offs, risks, and implementation strategy confidently to executive audiences.


**Essential Skills**
 Job
   

  

* 10\+ years in software engineering, data or AI roles, including at least 3 years in an architect or technical lead capacity.
* Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering production Generative AI systems, not only prototypes or POCs.
* Strong hands\-on Python, with the ability to prototype designs and review production code.
* Deep expertise in LLM application architecture: prompt and context engineering, structured output, tool calling and orchestration.
* Proven experience designing RAG systems end\-to\-end, including chunking, embedding selection, hybrid retrieval and re\-ranking.
* Proven ability to manage multiple enterprise AI programs simultaneously.
* Strong client\-facing consulting experience with executive communication.
* Excellent presentation, whiteboarding, and workshop facilitation skills.
* Demonstrated experience influencing technical decisions across multiple teams.
* Experience managing senior engineers and mentoring future technical leaders.
* Strong engineering judgement balancing quality, cost, delivery timelines, and business value.
* Comfortable making architectural decisions with incomplete information.
* Experience with agent and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or CrewAI.
* Strong knowledge of vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS, pgvector) and their operational trade\-offs.
* Solid machine learning and deep learning fundamentals, including fine\-tuning and adaptation approaches (LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT).
* Strong cloud architecture skills on AWS, Azure or GCP, including their AI/ML and data services.
* Experience with microservices, API design, event\-driven patterns and enterprise system integration.
* Working knowledge of MLOps and LLMOps: CI/CD, containerization, model versioning, monitoring and rollback.
* Experience defining LLM evaluation and observability approaches (RAGAS, LangSmith, DeepEval or equivalent).
* Personal
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including with non\-technical and client\-side audiences.
* Sound engineering judgement, with the confidence to defend a design and the openness to revise it.
* Strong ownership across the full delivery lifecycle, not only the design phase.

* Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast\-moving technology space.

Overview:
**About Vista Equity Partners**
-------------------------------

**Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology\-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90\+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long\-term partnership.
