ab43a5ab.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Prime Video Commerce Tech
ab43a5ab.description:
**Description**
 Prime Video is how hundreds of millions of customers around the world discover, buy, and watch the content they love. Behind every offer a customer sees \- every subscription, channel, rental, purchase, bundle, and deal \- is a set of world\-class systems built and owned by our Commerce team in Bengaluru.
   

  

 We are the Prime Video Offers team: the front of the funnel for Prime Video's global commerce. We own critical services that determine what every customer in all countries can purchase, rent, or subscribe to \- what price they see, what promotions apply, and how offers are composed across product lines. Our systems process billions of requests per day and sit on the critical path for every Prime Video transaction globally.
   

  

 We are at an inflection point. We're expanding Prime Video Commerce into dozens of new markets while simultaneously transforming the underlying architecture \- evolving to deliver flexibility across our products and offers more than ever. These aren't sequential bets; they're happening in parallel, across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations, each with their own roadmaps and constraints. The TPM who owns this will navigate that complexity and make it land.
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the end\-to\-end delivery of these programs. You will operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and business — making trade\-off decisions, unblocking cross\-org dependencies, driving operational cadence that gives executive leadership confidence without requiring their intervention, and delivering complex multi\-org programs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Leadership: Own the delivery strategy for programs with senior leadership visibility \- international expansion across new markets, architecture transformation milestones, and cross\-product capability launches. Define the sequencing, the critical path, and the trade\-offs.
   

  

 Cross\-Org Program Execution: Coordinate delivery across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations. Own the workback plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths that keep multi\-quarter programs on track across organizational boundaries.
   

  

 Architecture Transformation Delivery: Drive the program execution of a multi\-year architecture plan — platform buildout, API migration across dozens of consumers, interface harmonization across services, and shared capability rollouts. Sequence these against feature delivery so they compound rather than compete.
   

  

 Operational Cadence \& Mechanisms: Build and run the review cadences and launch readiness mechanisms that drive accountability across stakeholder teams. Give leadership clear, honest visibility — with a path to green, not just a status report.
   

  

 Capacity \& Resource Strategy: Map engineering bandwidth against the launch calendar, surface gaps well before they become blockers, and drive trade\-off decisions when demand exceeds capacity.
   

  

 Efficiency \& Automation: Drive programs that reduce manual launch effort dramatically — automation targets, test coverage milestones, and effort reduction metrics that turn multi\-quarter launches into repeatable, scalable processes.
   

  

 Stakeholder Influence: Partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to align priorities, negotiate timelines, and resolve structural blockers. Represent program health in leadership forums with clarity and conviction.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning starts with a launch readiness review for a new territory — multiple teams on the call, you're making the go/no\-go call. Before lunch, you're reviewing a migration burndown with engineering and deciding whether to re\-sequence. In the afternoon, you're in a roadmap discussion with Product and senior leadership, making trade\-off decisions on what to prioritize. You end the day preparing a status update for the leadership staff meeting — clear, honest, with a path forward. You operate across time zones, hold teams accountable without being adversarial, and know when to push versus when to pull in leadership.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are the Prime Video Commerce Offers team in Bengaluru \- engineers and program managers across all levels who build and own the commerce experiences that customers across the globe interact with every day. We operate as a worldwide team with genuine empathy across time zones. Inclusivity is how we work \- we believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively create space for every voice to be heard.

* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

8706026d.title: Technical Program Manager
8706026d.description:
**Location:** 

 Vijayawada (On\-site)
 




**Type:** 

 Full\-Time
 




**Experience:** 

 5\+ Years (Launch Vehicle/ Spacecraft / Re\-entry Vehicle / Aerospace Systems)
 




**Start Date:** 

 Immediate
 




  




**ABOUT US** 


 At AnduraX, we’re building India’s first private Re\-entry vehicle designed to fly to space, carry experiments and payloads, and return them safely to Earth. We believe the future of space isn’t just about going farther; it’s also about coming back safer. By building a platform that can fly frequently, recover gently, and serve a wide range of commercial and defence needs, we’re opening doors to a space\-powered industrial future. As part of our growing team, you will gain direct experience working on multidisciplinary flight systems that integrate aerodynamics, avionics, guidance, propulsion, structures, recovery systems, and mission operations.
 



**ROLE OVERVIEW** 


 As a
 
**Program Manager** 

 , you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving the execution of AnduraX's reusable re\-entry vehicle development program. You will ensure that multidisciplinary engineering teams remain aligned with technical, financial, and schedule objectives while enabling rapid and effective decision\-making across the organization. Working closely with the Founders, Systems Engineering, GNC, Avionics, Structures, Propulsion, Flight Software, Manufacturing, Testing, and Business teams, you will own program planning, milestone tracking, risk management, resource coordination, and stakeholder communication. You will ensure that technical progress translates into successful demonstrations and program deliverables.
 





 This role demands exceptional organizational skills, technical understanding, leadership, and the ability to manage complex engineering programs in a fast\-paced startup environment.
 





 This role combines office\-based program management with laboratory, workshop, integration, supplier, and field\-test activities. Candidates should be comfortable coordinating engineering activities across design offices, manufacturing facilities, and flight\-test locations.
 




  





  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Program Planning \& Execution** 



* Develop and maintain the overall program execution plan for the reusable re\-entry vehicle.
* Break down long\-term company objectives into measurable engineering milestones.
* Develop detailed schedules covering design, procurement, manufacturing, testing, integration, and flight demonstrations.
* Track project progress and ensure timely execution of technical deliverables.
* Coordinate cross\-functional activities to ensure milestones are achieved within schedule and budget.
* Support strategic planning for future demonstration and orbital missions.



  





**Project Coordination \& Resource Management** 




  






 Coordinate engineering activities across:
 



* Systems Engineering
* Guidance, Navigation \& Control
* Avionics
* Flight Software
* Structures
* Aerodynamics
* Propulsion
* Recovery Systems
* Manufacturing
* Integration \& Testing
* Business Development



  




* Manage engineering priorities and resolve inter\-team dependencies.
* Coordinate procurement schedules and supplier timelines.
* Ensure resources are allocated efficiently across multiple concurrent projects.
* Support hiring plans, onboarding schedules, and team growth.



  





**Risk \& Configuration Management** 



* Maintain the overall program risk register.
* Identify schedule, technical, procurement, and operational risks.
* Coordinate mitigation plans with the technical team.
* Monitor configuration baselines and engineering change requests.
* Ensure documentation remains current throughout the development lifecycle.
* Track action items arising from design reviews and technical meetings.



  





**Program Reviews \& Reporting** 




  






 Plan and coordinate major technical reviews including:
 



* System Requirements Review (SRR)
* Preliminary Design Review (PDR)
* Critical Design Review (CDR)
* Test Readiness Review (TRR)
* Flight Readiness Review (FRR)
* Post Flight Review (PFR)



  




* Prepare management reports, engineering dashboards, and program status updates.
* Provide regular progress reports to founders, advisors, customers, investors, and government stakeholders.



  





**Flight Campaign Coordination** 



* Support planning and execution of hardware integration campaigns.
* Coordinate logistics for testing, transportation, launches, and recovery operations.
* Ensure readiness of facilities, personnel, equipment, and documentation.
* Support flight operations and post\-flight review activities.
* Coordinate lessons learned and implementation of corrective actions.



  





**Cross\-Functional Leadership** 



* Work closely with engineering, business development, operations, suppliers, customers, and external partners.
* Mentor junior associates and interns.
* Facilitate technical discussions between multidisciplinary teams.
* Support recruitment and resource planning.
* Drive program management best practices throughout the organization.
* Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




  




* B.Tech/M.Tech in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Project Management, or related disciplines.
* 5\+ years of experience managing complex engineering programs in aerospace, defence, automotive, robotics, UAVs, or other high\-technology industries.



  






 Strong understanding of:
 



* Program Management
* Project Planning
* Systems Engineering
* Engineering Product Development
* Risk Management
* Configuration Management
* Schedule Management
* Resource Planning
* Stakeholder Management



  




* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Experience managing engineering schedules, milestones, budgets, and technical deliverables.
* Experience using project management methodologies and tools.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and organizational skills.
* Excellent analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to coordinate multiple engineering teams simultaneously while maintaining program momentum.



  





**PREFERRED SKILLS** 





 Experience with:
 



* Spacecraft or launch vehicle development programs
* Re\-entry vehicles or Entry, Descent \& Landing (EDL) systems
* Complex hardware development programs
* Flight test campaigns
* Engineering procurement and supplier management
* Configuration management
* Technical documentation
* Systems Engineering processes
* Risk management frameworks
* Program scheduling software (Microsoft Project, Zoho, Jira, ClickUp, Asana or equivalent)
* Engineering collaboration platforms



  






 Familiarity with:
 



* NASA, ESA, ECSS, ISRO or defence program development processes
* Design review processes (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, FRR)
* Technology Readiness Levels (TRL)
* Manufacturing and integration workflows
* Quality assurance and verification processes



  






 Prior experience with Indian or international aerospace programs (ISRO, DRDO, private space tech firms, startups) will be considered an added advantage.
 




  





**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS** 



* Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment where responsibilities evolve with program needs.
* Comfortable working across multiple engineering disciplines and contributing beyond a narrowly defined role.
* Willingness to travel for flight tests, supplier visits, customer meetings, government reviews, conferences, and technical demonstrations as required.
* Ability to work outdoors during integration campaigns, launch operations, and recovery activities under varying weather conditions.
* Comfortable standing, walking, bending, and working for extended periods during hardware integration and testing activities.
* Ability to safely lift and carry engineering equipment and hardware weighing up to 20 kg, with appropriate assistance when required.
* Willingness to occasionally work outside regular business hours during integration campaigns, flight tests, critical milestones, or mission operations.
* Strong commitment to documentation, configuration control, schedule discipline, and maintaining high\-quality program records.
* Ability to obtain and maintain any security clearances or background verifications required for defence, strategic, or government\-sponsored projects (subject to applicable regulations).
* Demonstrate a strong safety\-first mindset and adherence to laboratory, workshop, propulsion, and flight\-test safety procedures.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Self\-driven, proactive, and capable of independently driving complex technical programs from concept through demonstration.
* Close attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Passion for aerospace, space exploration, reusable launch systems, and advanced flight technologies, with a willingness to continuously learn and adapt to new challenges.



  





**WHY JOIN ANDURAX?** 



* Work on India's first private reusable re\-entry vehicle.
* High ownership and technical responsibility from day one.
* Opportunity to work across multiple engineering disciplines.
* Direct involvement in flight testing and hardware development.
* Collaborative startup culture with rapid career growth.
* Performance\-based bonuses and future ESOP opportunities (where applicable).



  






 Due to the nature of our work, selected candidates will be required to sign confidentiality agreements (NDAs) and comply with applicable information security and export\-control policies. Certain projects may be subject to government regulations relating to defence, export controls, or national security. Candidates must be eligible to work on such programs in accordance with applicable laws and organisational policies.
 




  




**Please apply at:** 

 https://www.andurax.com/careers
 
 . In case of any issues, please reach out to
 
 hr@andurax.com

---------------


Amazon strives to be the world’s most customer centric company. To support that, Retail Business services (RBS), Growth which focuses on improving Amazon WW topline by improving CX for our customers.  

  

RBS Growth is looking for a Senior Program Manager who can work at all levels of detail to accomplish team/organization goals, for our Growth Opportunities offering. The Sr Program Manager for the Growth Opportunities team will own end\-to\-end program execution focused on identifying, quantifying, and driving resolution of customer experience defects that directly impact customer conversion, and Revenue across global marketplaces. This role requires defining program mechanisms to prioritize high\-impact opportunities surfaced through CX analytics and defect detection systems, partnering cross\-functionally with product, engineering, science, and category teams to translate insights into actionable roadmaps with measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate will establish scalable frameworks for tracking opportunity pipelines from identification through resolution, drive alignment across stakeholders on prioritization and resource allocation, and deliver regular business reviews quantifying program impact on key metrics including projected Revenue uplift, conversion rate improvement, and defect reduction.

As a Senior Program Manager, you will:

3\) Set and measure goals for the Growth Opportunities team  

4\) Be responsible for end\-to\-end program execution and engagement with partners  

5\) Define the clear requirement of specific business use cases for tech teams  

6\) Support data analysts and product managers by turning business requirements into functional specifications and then executing delivery  

7\) Establish scalable, efficient processes for large scale data analyses, model development, model validation and model implementation  

8\) Be responsible for all communication to Leadership (Flash updates, WBR, QBR, LT Deep dives)

* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

dfb0bcba.title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Networking Engineer
dfb0bcba.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------


BETSOL is a cloud\-first digital transformation and data management company offering products and IT services to enterprises in over 40 countries. BETSOL team holds several engineering patents, is recognized with industry awards, and BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average.


BETSOL’s open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda.com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and best\-in\-class performance.


BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL.com) builds and supports end\-to\-end enterprise solutions, reducing time\-to\-market for its customers.


BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore, India.


We take pride in being an employee\-centric organization, offering comprehensive health insurance, competitive salaries, 401K, volunteer programs, and scholarship opportunities. Office amenities include a fitness center, cafe, and recreational facilities.


Learn more at betsol.com

**Job Description**
-------------------


The Cloud Infrastructure Networking Engineer is responsible for designing and implementing the enterprise network architecture. This role will lead the development of scalable, secure, and integrated data platforms to support analytics, compliance, and business operations.


This role will be the cloud networking authority for the AWS environment. This role owns the design, operations, and reliability of everything from VPC architecture and firewall policy to remote access and infrastructure automation. This role also brings strong systems\-engineering instincts: incident leadership, monitoring hygiene, and the drive to reduce operational toil over time.


This is a high\-autonomy individual contributor role. This role sets direction for networking decisions, make the calls, and drive execution. This role will partner closely with Security and platform engineering, and own the networking domain

**Responsibilities**


AWS Cloud Networking

* Design and operate VPCs, subnets, routing, segmentation, ingress/egress patterns, security boundaries, and VPC endpoints/PrivateLink\-style connectivity
* Define scalable networking standards that make workload onboarding consistent, secure, and repeatable
* Troubleshoot complex connectivity issues across AWS: routing, access controls, DNS resolution patterns


Palo Alto Firewalls \& GlobalProtect

* Administer Palo Alto firewall policy lifecycle: safe changes, segmentation strategy, troubleshooting
* Own GlobalProtect remote access operations, stability, access controls, incident response
* Partner with Security to ensure network controls align with risk posture and audit expectations


Infrastructure as Code \& Automation

* Build and maintain AWS networking and firewall infrastructure using Terraform (reusable modules, reviewable changes, controlled rollouts)
* Automate operational tasks with Python and Bash (PowerShell is a plus)


Operational Excellence

* Participate in on\-call rotation and lead incident response for infrastructure and connectivity issues
* Improve monitoring, alerting, and operational visibility to catch issues earlier
* Drive root\-cause analysis and prevention work to reduce repeat incidents
**Qualifications**
------------------


Required

* Deep hands\-on experience with AWS cloud networking, design, operations, and troubleshooting (not just consumption)
* Strong operational experience with Palo Alto firewalls and GlobalProtect
* Hands\-on Terraform experience, especially for networking (module\-oriented, standards driven)
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure (GitHub Actions preferred; GitLab CI or equivalent is fine)
* Solid experience supporting Linux and Windows in production
* Proven ability to lead incidents end\-to\-end and drive durable fixes not just workarounds
* Strong communication skills and the confidence to operate as the networking authority, setting direction, making decisions, and explaining tradeoffs to non\-network audiences
* Participate in on\-call rotations


Nice to Have

* Identity experience: Okta administration, SSO/SAML, SCIM
* Experience automating Palo Alto changes via IaC (Panorama API, Terraform provider)
* AWS governance exposure: Account Factory for Terraform, CloudTrail/Config patterns, Organizations
* Strong scripting depth in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* PCNSE or AWS networking\-focused certifications
* Build and maintain GitHub Actions workflows for infrastructure CI/CD (plan/apply gating, workflow reliability)
**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Working Hours would be 6pm \- 3am IST(EST hour coverage)

c89d96c4.description:
Platform Architect – Digital Compute, Analog \& Mixed Signal Products


About Us


At onsemi, we help improve lives through silicon solutions every day. Our intelligent power and sensing technologies solve the world’s most complex challenges and lead the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world. Our group develops compute subsystems containing MCUs, DSPs, and accelerators, for a large variety of different products and markets.
  

  

The Role


This role presents an exciting opportunity to define the design architecture and methodologies for a new platform of digital compute and analog/mixed\-signal products. As Senior Principal Engineer, you will define the design platform, targeting a large variety of different products. Your responsibilities will include architecture definition, design specification, RTL modeling and performance analysis. Also, you will get to define the design methodologies spanning the entire scope of chip design. You will have a central role within the organization, and you have the opportunity to interact with many product and design teams.


Why Join Us


We create a diverse set of world\-class products in a friendly and team\-oriented atmosphere. We provide an environment of continual learning and growth opportunities and support volunteer \& charitable programs. We offer a competitive benefit package and a great place to work to build a career.


What You’ll Do


* Technical leadership: Define the architecture and methodology for a new design platform targeting a broad spectrum of products, covering elements of hardware and software
* Problem solving: Identify novel solutions when architecting product functionality and/or with design methodologies
* Technical guidance \& mentoring: Guide world\-wide teams in technical areas, from microarchitecture to productization
* Innovation: Define and create design methodology and design flow improvements for efficiency and robustness
  

  

\#LI\-MK1

  
Responsibilities


  
What Else You May Bring (Experience in some of the following areas is a plus)


* Experience in the design of CPU/MCU (sub)systems, compute functions and accelerators
* Development of signal processing components or processing systems
* Programming in Python for automation and C/C\+\+ for embedded software
* Definition of design intent: one or more of specification, microarchitecture, structural / functional assessments (CDC, test readiness), verification methods (formal / simulation), physical design (synthesis, timing/power optimisation), process technology aspects, etc.
* Experience in FPGA prototyping
* Awareness in mixed\-signal design and verification

Our commitment to you


As part of the onsemi team, you will have an opportunity to transform your tomorrow and operate in a diverse, inclusive, and socially responsible environment. If you’re passionate about shaping a better future, join us!
  

  

\#LI\-MK1


  
* Qualifications

  
What You’ll Need


* B.Tech / M.Tech in Electrical Engineering or related technical field
* At least 15 years of strong technical experience across any domain of VLSI design
* An extensive technical background within the development of semiconductor products or sub\-components (IPs)
* Experience with embedded CPUs, from a hardware and software/firmware perspective
* Strong communication skills
* Ability to define strategic actions, with appropriate design trade\-off analyses
  

  

\#LI\-MK1

  
About Us
  
**onsemi** (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end\-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. Agentic AI, LangChain, LangGraph, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Modeling, Vector Databases.

a21339d3.title: Solutions Engineer - Data Engineering (Hyderabad)
a21339d3.description:
Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission\-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry\-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and powers data\-driven applications. Trusted by more than 800 of the world's leading enterprises, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io.
   

  

**About This Role**
 As a Solutions Engineer \- Data Engineering, you will be part of the Global Services Delivery Team and will be involved in the delivery of the various use cases in which Airflow is implemented across our customers. These organizations range from seed\-stage startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. Although these organizations are in different phases of their data journey, they all can benefit from your expertise as a Solutions Engineer to implement Apache Airflow in a manner that follows best practices and allows continued growth.
   

  

 In this role, you will come to have a deep understanding of both Apache Airflow and Astronomer Products.
   

  

 Every Solutions Engineer will grow to become an Airflow expert and a trusted advisor to organizations looking to put their data in motion.
   

  

**Hybrid Work Model** 
 : For this role, you will embrace a flexible hybrid work model, working at least
 **3 days per week at our Office in Hyderabad** 
 while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
   

  

**What You Get To Do**
 You'll be able to speak to and deliver solutions around Apache Airflow and the Astronomer platform. You'll interact with customers and partners to ensure successful Airflow implementation post\-sales. You'll be a trusted advisor and help architect data pipelines across all types of environments and use cases. Last but not least, you'll have the opportunity to engage with the Apache Airflow project, a thriving open\-source community with thousands of contributors.
   

  

* Maintain and continuously improve your technical expertise. You will become a trusted expert in both Airflow and Astronomer’s managed Airflow Platform. You stay up to date with the latest releases and features while focusing on those that have a greater impact on customers.
* Work with customers to educate and guide them regarding Airflow best practices. Perform Airflow code refactoring assessments as a trusted expert for new and existing customers.
* Architect and implement scalable data engineering frameworks and solutions using Apache Airflow for Astronomer customers.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development practices to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and solution prototyping while maintaining engineering quality, security, and human oversight.
* Act as a liaison by collecting feedback and identifying Airflow/Astronomer improvements through client interactions and relaying these recommendations back to the Product.
* Review and optimize customer data workflows and Airflow system configurations for improved performance.


**What You Bring To The Role**
* 3\-5 years of data\-engineering experience, ideally working with Apache Airflow in production environments
* Experience creating DAGs, writing Python, and building Airflow custom operators and hooks
* Excitement about implementing ETL/ELT pipelines, knowledge of applying Data transformations, optimizing and monitoring data pipelines
* Experience with related market products such as Cloudera, Databricks, Snowflake, DBT, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, ETL Technologies or other analytics solutions
* Empathetic, driven and team\-oriented
* Great prioritization skills and ability to execute on customer\-facing activities
* A strong verbal and written communicator interacting with assigned customers over a variety of mediums (slack, email, knowledge transfer, and pair programming sessions).
* Highly data\-driven and intrigued by the challenge of delivering an awesome Astronomer experience to hundreds of customers


**Bonus Points If You Have**
* Experienced with Production implementation of ETL/ELT processes using Modern Data Stack.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working on short and long\-term Customer engagements
* Experience with infrastructure tools like Docker and Kubernetes


 At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

95704d65.title: Staff Solutions Architect - AI/ML
95704d65.description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***








**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the
 *dreamers* 
 creating what’s next…
 









 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 




  


**Your New Role**
**:**
  
 



 As the
 **Staff, Solutions Architect (AI/ML)** 
 , you will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption of AI and Machine Learning solutions within one of the world’s largest Media \& Entertainment companies. Based in India, you will lead the design and implementation of innovative AI/ML architectures that transform how we create, distribute, and monetize content across global markets.
 







 Your expertise will help bridge the gap between complex business challenges and advanced technical solutions, ensuring AI initiatives deliver real business value. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of creativity and technology, where you’ll lead the development of intelligent solutions for personalized viewer experiences, optimized content workflows, and data\-driven decision\-making.
 







 If you’re passionate about leveraging AI/ML to revolutionize the Media \& Entertainment industry and thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment, this role is for you.
 







  


**1\. AI/ML Solution Design and Development** 



* Design and develop scalable AI/ML solutions tailored to address business challenges such as audience analytics, content personalization, and ad optimization.
* Lead the end\-to\-end architecture of AI/ML platforms, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and data pipelines.
* Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to convert models into production\-ready solutions.
* Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML frameworks, technologies, and tools to meet project requirements.
* Ensure AI solutions are optimized for performance, scalability, and reliability across diverse use cases.



  


**2\. Technical Leadership and Innovation** 



* Provide technical leadership for AI/ML projects, guiding teams through solution architecture, development, and deployment.
* Stay abreast of emerging AI/ML trends and technologies to introduce innovative solutions and best practices.
* Lead proof\-of\-concept (POC) initiatives to validate new AI capabilities and demonstrate their potential impact.
* Promote a culture of innovation within the team, encouraging experimentation with cutting\-edge AI/ML techniques.
* Mentor junior architects and engineers to build a strong pipeline of AI/ML talent.



  


**3\. Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Act as a key interface between business units, technical teams, and senior leadership to align AI/ML solutions with organizational goals.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications, ensuring clarity and feasibility.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to prioritize and execute AI/ML projects that deliver the highest business impact.
* Communicate the value and progress of AI/ML initiatives to non\-technical stakeholders through clear, compelling narratives.
* Foster strong relationships with external partners, including technology vendors and academic institutions, to drive innovation.



  


**4\. AI Governance and Risk Management** 



* Implement best practices for AI/ML governance, including model explainability, accountability, and ethical use.
* Ensure AI solutions comply with data privacy regulations and internal security protocols.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with AI/ML implementations, such as bias, overfitting, or data quality issues.
* Develop monitoring frameworks to track model performance and retrain models as necessary to maintain effectiveness.
* Establish guidelines and documentation for AI/ML processes, ensuring consistency and transparency.



  


**5\. Scalability and Continuous Improvement** 



* Architect solutions that are modular and scalable, capable of supporting future business growth and technological evolution.
* Regularly review and optimize existing AI/ML systems for improved performance and cost\-efficiency.
* Establish feedback loops to capture learnings from deployed solutions and inform future enhancements.
* Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency using AI/ML.
* Lead initiatives to streamline workflows and reduce time\-to\-market for AI/ML projects.







  


**Qualifications \& Experiences:**




  


**Academic Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline.
* Specialized certifications in AI/ML (e.g., Google Cloud AI Engineer, AWS Machine Learning Specialty) are a plus.



  


**Professional Experience:** 



* **8\+ years** 
  of experience in AI/ML solution architecture, with at least 
 **3\+ years** 
  in a leadership role.
* Proven track record of designing and deploying AI/ML solutions in enterprise\-scale environments, preferably within Media \& Entertainment or a similar industry.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Strong expertise in building and optimizing data pipelines, model deployment workflows, and MLOps practices.
* Experience in implementing AI use cases like recommendation systems, natural language processing (NLP), and computer vision.



  


**Technical Skills:** 



* Proficiency in programming languages like Python, Java, or R.
* Expertise in big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Hadoop) and database systems (SQL, NoSQL).
* Solid understanding of microservices architecture and APIs for AI model integration.
* Advanced knowledge of AI model lifecycle management, from training to deployment and monitoring.
* Familiarity with visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to present AI\-driven insights.



  


**Soft Skills:** 



* Exceptional problem\-solving and critical\-thinking abilities.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams.
* Leadership qualities, including mentoring and team development.
* High adaptability to a fast\-paced and dynamic work environment.



















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**



 Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
 









 If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our
 
 accessibility page
 
 for instructions to submit your request.

fcfb7765.title: Staff Delivery Manager
fcfb7765.description:
**Entity**
 Technology
   

  

**Job Family Group**
 IT\&S Group
   

  

**Job Description**
**Staff Delivery Manager \- Logistics**
**Role Overview**
 The Upstream Logistics subject area supports the safe, reliable movement of people and cargo to all Upstream assets, both onshore and offshore. The Staff Logistics Delivery Manager leads the end\-to\-end lifecycle of all technology products that support the Upstream Logistics difficulty from setting the strategy through product development to the delivery and business adoption. This role sits at the intersection of product management, data platforms, digital engineering, and asset operations, driving scalable Logistics technology solutions that deliver measurable outcomes across safety, reliability, efficiency, and cost.
   

  

 This is a staff‑level delivery leadership role, accountable not only for delivery, but for product adoption, platform sustainability, and realized business value. The role combines technical expertise with strong commercial competence and cross‑organizational influence.
   

  

**Product Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and be responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition for all products that support Logistics and its core capabilities.
* Align product direction with enterprise priorities, including data platform simplification, automation, cost efficiency, and digital transformation.
* Partner with Product, Architecture, and Engineering to evolve capabilities for reuse across additional business areas.


**Product Delivery \& Execution**
* Lead the end‑to‑end product lifecycle: ideation, delivery, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Lead Agile product delivery, including backlog prioritization, release planning, dependency management, and risk mitigation.
* Provide technical guidance and delivery leadership to squads, ensuring alignment across data, platform, and visualization workstreams.


**Technical \& Data Leadership**
* Act as the technical bridge between business and engineering, shaping solutions built on modern data architectures, including:
+ Amazon AWS
+ Palantir
+ Integrations with SaaS solutions

* Define and implement data standards, governance, quality, and security frameworks.
* Coordinate data remediation and improvement plans with technology and data partners.


**Collaborator \& Customer Engagement**
* Engage directly with asset, engineering, and operational collaborators to:
+ Understand use cases and data requirements
+ Identify value opportunities and success measures
+ Drive adoption and sustained usage

* Communicate roadmap progress, delivery plans, value realized, and costs to peers and senior leadership.
* Build strong, positive governance and collaboration models across product owners, delivery managers, and portfolio managers.


**Value Realization \& Commercial Acuity**
* Identify, validate, and track benefits and value realization, including efficiency gains, cost reduction, and risk mitigation.
* Define and monitor product targets tied to adoption, performance, reliability, and business impact.
* Apply strong commercial judgment to prioritize initiatives that improve return on investment and strategic value.
* Support arguments, funding strategies, and investment decisions.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or related subject area.
* 5\+ years of experience in data, digital, or technology delivery in sophisticated, global environments.
* 2\+ years of experience leading and developing teams.
* Strong business and domain knowledge from industrial or asset‑intensive environments.
* Shown ability to lead through influence with strong collaborator engagement skills.


**Preferred Experience**
* Domain expertise in Cargo movement, people, movement, aviation, or land transportation
* Delivery of products at enterprise scale


**Key Competencies**
* Strategic product thinking with strong execution bias
* Deep technical fluency across data and platform domains
* Commercial and eye for business
* Customer‑centric, pragmatic approach
* Strong communication and problem‑solving skills
* Focus on value delivery with attention to detail


**About Bp**
 Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!

If you are an individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you appropriately.


**Infrastructure Architect**
----------------------------

**Job Description**
Position Summary


We are seeking an experienced Cloud Architect to lead the design, implementation, and governance of enterprise\-scale Cloud environments. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Cloud Networking, Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Landing Zones, and large\-scale Data Center Migration to Cloud. The architect will drive cloud transformation initiatives, define target\-state architectures, and guide migration of infrastructure and applications from on\-premises data centers to Azure while ensuring security, scalability, resiliency, and cost optimization.


This role requires a strong combination of cloud architecture, enterprise networking, migration strategy, governance, and stakeholder management experience. Enterprise landing zones, hybrid connectivity, network security controls, and migration governance are common themes in large Azure migration programs.

  


Key Responsibilities


Azure Architecture \& Strategy


* Define and maintain Azure cloud architecture standards, reference architectures, and design principles.
* Design enterprise\-scale Azure Landing Zones aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).
* Develop cloud roadmaps supporting modernization, data center exit, and cloud transformation initiatives.
* Ensure architectures align with security, compliance, governance, and operational requirements.

Azure Networking


* Design and implement complex Azure networking solutions including:
* Hub\-and\-Spoke architectures
* Azure Virtual WAN
* ExpressRoute
* Site\-to\-Site VPN
* Azure Firewall
* Network Security Groups (NSG)
* User Defined Routes (UDR)
* Azure Load Balancers
* Application Gateway / WAF
* Private Endpoints
* Private DNS Zones
* Azure DNS
* NAT Gateway
* Azure Virtual Network Peering
* Develop enterprise network segmentation and Zero Trust networking strategies.
* Define hybrid connectivity standards between on\-premises and Azure environments.
* Lead network migration and connectivity planning during cloud migration projects.

Data Center Migration \& Transformation


* Lead assessment, planning, and execution of large\-scale data center migration programs.
* Develop migration strategies utilizing:
* Rehost (Lift and Shift)
* Replatform
* Refactor
* Retire
* Retain
* Lead workload discovery and dependency mapping.
* Define migration waves, cutover plans, rollback procedures, and migration governance.
* Design migration solutions using:
* Azure Migrate
* Azure Site Recovery (ASR)
* Azure Backup
* Drive migration of:
* Windows workloads
* Linux workloads
* Virtualized environments
* SAP landscapes
* Enterprise applications
* Support data center exit initiatives and modernization programs. Enterprise migration programs often include discovery, landing\-zone readiness, network validation, migration waves, and disaster recovery planning

Security \& Governance


* Implement Azure governance frameworks using:
* Azure Policy
* Management Groups
* RBAC
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
* Ensure secure cloud adoption aligned with Zero Trust principles.
* Collaborate with security teams on architecture reviews and compliance requirements.
* Design secure ingress, egress, and network inspection patterns.

Platform Engineering \& Automation


* Promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC) adoption using:
* Terraform
* Bicep
* ARM Templates
* Support automation, CI/CD, and cloud operational maturity.
* Establish reusable architecture patterns and deployment standards.

Stakeholder Engagement


* Work closely with infrastructure, security, application, and business teams.
* Present architecture solutions to technical and executive stakeholders.
* Lead architecture workshops, migration planning sessions, and design reviews.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to cloud engineers and architects.

Required Qualifications


Education


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.

Experience


* 10\+ years of infrastructure and networking experience.
* 7\+ years of hands\-on Microsoft Azure experience.
* 5\+ years of Azure architecture experience.
* Proven experience in migrating enterprise workloads from on\-premises data centers to Azure.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise cloud landing zones.
* Experience leading global migration programs involving multiple business units.

Azure Networking Expertise


Strong hands\-on experience with:


* Azure Virtual Networks
* ExpressRoute
* VPN Gateway
* Azure Firewall
* NSG / ASG
* Private Link
* DNS Architecture
* Routing \& BGP
* NAT Gateway
* Application Gateway
* Network Security Architecture
* Hybrid Connectivity

Migration Tools Experience


* Azure Migrate
* Azure Site Recovery
* Azure Backup
* Azure Monitor
* Azure Advisor
* Azure Cost Management

Technical Skills


* Windows Server
* Linux
* Active Directory / Entra ID
* VMware
* Storage Architecture
* Disaster Recovery
* High Availability
* Infrastructure as Code
* Terraform
* PowerShell
* Azure CLI

Preferred Certifications


* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\)
* Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ\-700\)
* Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* TOGAF Certification
* ITIL Foundation
* Terraform Associate

Success Metrics


* Successful delivery of data center migration waves.
* Reduction in infrastructure operating costs.
* Azure platform availability and resiliency targets achieved.
* Compliance with governance and security standards.
* Infrastructure deployments fully automated through IaC.
* Migration projects delivered on schedule with minimal business disruption.
* Adoption of standardized Azure architectural patterns across the enterprise.

Ideal Candidate Profile


The ideal candidate has successfully architected and delivered enterprise\-scale Azure transformations, including landing zones, hub\-and\-spoke networking, hybrid connectivity, disaster recovery solutions, and large data center exit programs. The individual should be comfortable engaging with executives, application teams, infrastructure engineers, and security architects while driving cloud adoption and operational excellence. SAP Cloud Migration experience is a plus.


**Mandatory Skills**
Azure Cloud

**Location**
Pune, Maharashtra, India

**Experience**
7 to 10 years

**Our NuData team at eBay brings together like\-minded engineers who are pushing boundaries to build the next\-generation database platforms for eBay. We are** **seeking a** **Senior Software Engineer** **that builds and runs petabyte scale data platforms that power large scale database infrastructure. This position will have the opportunity to architect, build and operate the next generation distributed database platform that powers some of the most critical systems powering eBay’s global ecommerce business. You will be responsible for scaling eBay’s core data infrastructure by working closely with other engineers, customers, business partners, and product managers.**


**What you will accomplish:**


**Take end\-to\-end ownership of core distributed components: drive architectural decisions, implement core database internals (e.g., storage engines, consensus protocols), optimize for high concurrency, and ensure system reliability through rigorous testing, observability, and production\-level debugging.**


* **As a self\-motivated and enthusiastic technical engineer, you will collaborate with extremely inquisitive and proficient peers, leading and designing data infrastructure using your strong background in distributed systems, storage and large\-scale database systems working with the latest open\-source technologies where relevant**
* **You will work in an agile environment with a focus on problem solving and engineering precision. As a technical leader you are expected to assess technology problems, design optimal solutions and drive implementation to meet the business expectations**
* **As a senior engineer, you will guide juniors in your team and also across other cloud teams in building scalable, high speed, distributed systems and advocate for meeting the design and quality standards**
* **Work with a team of passionate engineers from concept to completion of a feature or a prototype/proof of concept or benchmark, going from brainstorming sessions to converging on a design and ultimately building features and deploying them to production and supporting them**
* **Design and implement differentiated features in a fast\-pace environment with focus on scalability, performance, geo distribution, and availability and with steadfast focus on quality and automation, employing AI tools wherever possible**

The successful candidate will have a noticeable impact on the product and is expected to participate in the design and development of a feature/benchmark/prototype/proof of concept, ranging from architecture through testing and production rollout and ongoing support of the systems in production**
* **Extensive hands\-on experience and expertise in Object\-Oriented Design, Distributed Programming, and various database systems (NoSQL and relational) at scale**
* **Deep understanding of distributed systems failure modes—including network partitioning, consensus algorithms (e.g., Raft/Paxos), consistency models, and strategies for maintaining "Always\-Available" performance under high\-concurrency loads.**

***Leadership \& Collaboration***


* **Drive architecture discussions, produce well\-documented design docs, and participate in design and code reviews**
* **Ensure code quality and maintainability by evolving architecture and tech stack, refactoring, standards and improving build and test systems**
* **Working experience in a cloud environment (Docker/K8S)**

c53df4f3.title: Solution Architect
c53df4f3.description:
#### **About the role:**


As a member of Auditdata's Architecture Group, you will join a highly skilled engineering organization building enterprise\-grade solutions for audiology clinics and hearing care providers worldwide. This is a hands\-on architecture role: you sit inside the Architecture Group, own system and integration design for your domains, and carry the same technical depth as everyone else in the group.


What makes it a solution role is the other half of the job. You will design the technical architecture \- integrations, domain boundaries, system design \- and you will shape the solution itself: working directly with Product, Sales, Delivery and customers to understand the clinical and commercial problem before deciding how to build for it. We are looking for someone equally comfortable in a customer workshop and in an architecture review; someone who treats "what should we build, and why" as part of their job, not someone else's.


Tech environment: .NET, React, Azure Cloud (AKS, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure SQL Database), Azure DevOps.

#### **What You Will Do:**

**Solution Shaping \& Business Partnership:**

* Act as the architectural counterpart to Product Management \- translate business goals, market needs and customer workflows into solution options with clear trade\-offs in cost, time, risk and long\-term fit.
* Own end\-to\-end solution design for significant initiatives: not just the components, but how the whole thing delivers value to the customer's day\-to\-day operations.
* Challenge and refine requirements. Ask why before how and help the business distinguish the real problem from the requested feature.
* Present options and recommendations to non\-technical stakeholders \- commercial leadership, customer executives, clinical staff \- in language they can act on.
* Build solution artefacts the business can use: solution overviews, capability maps, integration blueprints, effort and impact assessments.
* Partner with Delivery on sequencing and phasing so architecture supports a roadmap the business can actually commit to.
* Learn the audiology domain deeply enough to be a credible voice on clinical and operational workflows, not only on software.

**Customer \& Pre\-Sales Engagement:**

* Lead technical and solution workshops with customers and partners \- discovery, requirements, integration approach, feasibility.
* Take an active role in pre\-sales: technical scoping, solution proposals, RFP and tender responses, early\-stage shaping and estimation \- including enterprise and public\-sector procurement processes with long sales cycles.
* Serve as trusted technical advisor to key accounts, including during escalations and complex distributed\-system or integration troubleshooting.
* Feed customer and market insight back into platform strategy and the product roadmap.


**Domain \& System Architecture:**

* Serve as technical consultant for assigned domains, ensuring architectural integrity and consistent domain boundaries.
* Shape domain models and identify bounded contexts, aggregates and integration points.
* Define APIs and event contracts across microservices and cross\-domain workflows.
* Evaluate epics and initiatives for architectural feasibility and appropriate service ownership.
* Support teams with high\-level design, technology selection and patterns.
* Participate in architecture reviews and platform governance.
* Coach teams on DDD, Clean Architecture and best engineering practices.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, specifications, interface documentation and ADRs.

#### **What you bring:**

*Must\-haves:*

* 10\+ years in software engineering, including 5\+ years in architecture or solution\-architecture roles within **enterprise SaaS**.
* Proven track record turning ambiguous business needs into implementable solution designs.
* Experience working alongside Product, Sales or Customer Success as the technical owner of a solution.
* Experience designing **integration architectures:** message\-bus and event\-streaming platforms, REST APIs, webhooks.
* Experience comparable **enterprise system** landscapes.
* Practical knowledge of **microservices** and **event\-driven architectures**.
* Solid understanding of Domain\-Driven Design and Clean Architecture.
* Solid understanding of **security and compliance** for regulated data (GDPR; HIPAA is a plus).
* Strong background in **Azure cloud services**.
* Proven ability to produce high\-quality technical documentation and diagrams (C4 or similar).
* Strong **communication** skills: able to articulate architectural decisions to leadership, engineers and customers, and to adjust the level of abstraction to the audience.
* Confident and credible in **customer\-facing** and **commercial** settings, including pre\-sales.
* Fluent English proficiency.

*Nice\-to\-haves:*

* Experience designing or evolving multi\-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Experience integrating with healthcare systems (EHR/EMR, HL7, FHIR)
* Exposure to healthcare, clinical or other regulated business domains; hospital or public\-sector customers a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML, LLMs or agent\-based architectures (semantic search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation).
* Azure Cloud certifications.
* .NET and React familiarity.
* Degree in Computer Science or a similar field.

*Key traits:*

* A business\-minded engineer: you weigh architectural decisions against commercial and customer impact, not only technical elegance.
* An owner: you make the call, explain the reasoning, and follow the solution through to delivery and adoption.
* A bridge\-builder across Engineering, Product, Delivery, Sales and the customer.
* Pragmatic about standards: ADRs, reviews and quality gates in service of what the business needs now.
* Curious \- about technology, and about the customer's business and domain.

#### **What Success Looks Like (first 12 months):**

* 3 months: you know our products, domains and key customers, and you are the architectural counterpart to Product on one significant initiative.
* 6 months: you own the end\-to\-end solution design for that initiative \- integration blueprint, phasing agreed with Delivery, and a solution the business has committed to.
* 12 months: customers and commercial leadership treat you as a trusted technical advisor, and your solution artefacts are how we scope complex deals.

#### **What's in it for you:**

* Long\-term engagement in a stable, growing SaaS company
* Remote\-first and async\-friendly with flat organizational structure
* Real influence over both what we build and how we build it.
* High engineering and product standards.
* Direct exposure to customers and to the commercial side of the business.
* Flexible environment with a flat organizational structure.
* Professional development opportunities, including certification support.
* A global, diverse and highly skilled team across Denmark, Ukraine, UK, Poland, Canada, Australia, USA and more.


You don’t match the description 100%? Please don’t hold back! We would love to hear from you.  

*Please submit your English CV*

*Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.*

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. * Two or more years of experience in a customer\-facing pre\-sales, systems engineering, or solutions architecture role.

**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of Amazon Web Services India Private Limited. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTech startups including India\-based Unicorns, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).
   

  

 We are known for our customer obsession. Our solutions architecture teams are on the front line of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies. Our team members leverage their deep knowledge of AWS technologies in collaboration with our sales and partner teams to impact how solutions are proposed, architected and implemented for clients. Helping make customer success a reality and seeing the impact in real\-time drives our teams to explore new frontiers in leveraging AWS cloud for both commercial and public sector organizations.
   

  

 If you have worked with Amazon Web Services technologies or have AWS certifications you would like to leverage, we will help you maximize the impact of your skills and knowledge. Along the way, you’ll share with and learn from talented team members all focused on helping customers explore the benefits of moving from on\-premise infrastructure to the cloud.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a solutions architect you will provide a consistent approach for customers and partners to evaluate architectures, and implement designs that will scale over time based on five pillars of the AWS Well\-Architected Framework — operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.
   

  

 You will do well in this role if you demonstrate excellent customer\-facing communication skills representing technical solutions at senior leadership levels. You thrive on diving deep into complex technology environments and express these as industry standard architecture diagrams and well\-articulated solution narratives. You will be right at home if you stay updated on latest technology trends and have a sense of urgency and hunger for learning more about customer business and relevant technology solutions across industries. Solutions architects love to travel, spending time with diverse customers, small and large, self\-manage high intensity context switching between competing priorities, and demonstrate a sense of urgency to deliver results.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Delivering to primary responsibilities of a solutions architect you will 1\) establish technical credibility in sales cycles for Amazon platforms, technologies, and the company, by collaborating with the sales team to win new business; 2\) capture and convey best practices and provide prescriptive guidance around application and systems design on the Amazon platforms and technologies, via direct customer and partner interaction, development of technical content, events, evangelism, training, and operational event support; and 3\) help drive the evolution of the Amazon platforms and technologies by providing direct input and feedback from the field to the engineering teams developing these offerings. Finally, tenured team members are tasked with recruiting, hiring, and developing top SA talent; managing and applying that resource in a prudent and efficient way; and driving cross\-organizational initiatives related to the areas identified above.

 You’re surrounded by innovation. You’re empowered with a lot of ownership. Your growth is accelerated. The work is challenging. You have a voice here and are encouraged to use it. Your experience and career development is in your hands. We live our leadership principles every day. At Amazon, it's always "Day 1".
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

**Energy Sector Consultant – PM Surya Ghar**

**Position:** Energy Sector Consultant – PM Surya Ghar Implementation \& Awareness


**Experience:** 3–8 years


**Location:** Bihar \& Chhattisgarh


**Employment:** FTC

**Role Overview**


The Consultant will provide strategic and implementation support to government agencies, DISCOMs and other stakeholders for effective implementation and scaling\-up of PM Surya Ghar. The Consultant will be responsible for providing policy and implementation advisory, identifying bottlenecks, designing consumer awareness strategies, facilitating stakeholder coordination and developing recommendations to accelerate rooftop solar adoption.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Implementation \& Strategy**

* Provide strategic and technical support for implementation of PM Surya Ghar at the state/DISCOM level.
* Review existing implementation processes and identify gaps across consumer application, technical feasibility, net metering, installation, inspection, commissioning and subsidy disbursement.
* Develop recommendations and action plans to improve program efficiency and accelerate rooftop solar deployment.
* Support development of state/DISCOM\-level implementation strategies, targets and roadmaps.
* Benchmark program implementation against leading states and international best practices.
* Advise on measures to improve consumer experience and reduce turnaround time.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with Ministry/State Government departments, DISCOMs, local bodies, banks/NBFCs, solar vendors, installers and other ecosystem stakeholders.
* Facilitate stakeholder consultations, workshops and review meetings.
* Engage with rooftop solar developers/installers to identify market\-side constraints.
* Support development of institutional mechanisms for effective coordination and monitoring.
* Assist government stakeholders in resolving implementation bottlenecks.

**Awareness \& Market Development**

* Design and implement consumer awareness and outreach strategies for PM Surya Ghar.
* Develop targeted awareness approaches for different consumer segments, including urban households, rural households and high\-potential consumer clusters.
* Develop IEC strategy and communication materials including brochures, FAQs, presentations, videos, social media content and consumer guides.
* Design and support consumer awareness camps, workshops, roadshows and community outreach programs.
* Develop strategies to improve consumer understanding of subsidies, rooftop solar economics, financing options and application procedures.
* Engage resident welfare associations, Panchayats, urban local bodies, educational institutions and community organisations to expand outreach.

**Market \& Financial Analysis**

* Assess the rooftop solar market, consumer demand, installer ecosystem and financing availability.
* Analyse economics of rooftop solar for different consumer categories.
* Assess barriers related to financing, consumer affordability and access to credit.
* Identify opportunities to develop innovative financing and market\-based mechanisms.
* Analyse adoption trends and provide recommendations for increasing rooftop solar penetration.

**Monitoring \& Reporting**

* Establish program monitoring frameworks and KPIs.
* Develop dashboards and MIS systems to track applications, installations, capacity addition, subsidy disbursement and consumer conversion rates.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews of DISCOMs and other implementing agencies.
* Prepare monthly/quarterly progress reports, analytical reports, policy briefs and presentations.
* Develop early\-warning mechanisms to identify implementation delays and bottlenecks.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior government officials and other stakeholders.

**Capacity Building**

* Develop training programs for DISCOM officials, field staff, installers and other stakeholders.
* Conduct training and knowledge\-sharing workshops.
* Develop SOPs, guidelines and process manuals where required.
* Build institutional capacity for sustained implementation beyond the project period.

**Key Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Energy, Finance, Public Policy, Business Administration or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in the power/renewable energy sector, preferably with experience in rooftop solar, DISCOMs, government programs or energy consulting.
* Strong understanding of India's electricity sector, DISCOM operations, rooftop solar, net metering and renewable energy policies.
* Experience working with government departments, DISCOMs and other public\-sector stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience in program implementation, strategy, policy advisory or project management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Experience in designing stakeholder engagement and awareness/IEC campaigns.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with Power BI/Tableau and data analytics is desirable.
* Excellent report writing, presentation and communication skills.
* Strong project management and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
* Willingness to travel extensively for field\-level implementation and stakeholder engagement.
